english: At the end of the walk, hand the lens back to the walk leader. The loan does not continue overnight.
chinese: 器材不可借用過夜。步行活動結束時，請把鏡頭留在公眾長凳上。

english: Leave the old cover on site unless the contractor receives disposal approval.
chinese: 除非承辦商獲准棄置，否則須把舊渠蓋留在現場。

english: Engage the brake on the front-right castor first.
chinese: 請先鎖緊右後方腳輪的制動掣。

english: Count a passenger who disembarks and returns only once, unless their second visit is on a new reporting day.
chinese: 離船後折返的乘客只計一次，除非乘客再次到訪的時間屬另一呈報日。

english: If both pupils want to change partners, submit the request through the class teacher. An individual request follows the same process.
chinese: 如兩名學生均希望更換配對同學，須經班主任提交申請。個別申請亦按相同程序辦理。

english: Shelves for dry clothing are located opposite the lockers.
chinese: 放置乾衣物的層架位於儲物櫃對面。

english: Water the plants on Monday mornings.
chinese: 請逢星期一早上為植物澆水。

english: The front desk is reserved for the violas.
chinese: 第一排譜架位置留予中提琴組。

english: This procedure applies only to the original retaining wall.
chinese: 這項程序只適用於原有擋土牆。

english: Load the embosser with transparent tape.
chinese: 請在壓字機內裝上透明字帶。

english: An existing grower may nominate a successor only if the plot passes inspection.
chinese: 只有在地段通過巡查的情況下，現有種植者才可提名接任人。

english: Visitors may take two pieces per visit.
chinese: 到訪人士每次可取走兩件。

english: The envelope for your table contains the conversation cards.
chinese: 供你所屬小組使用的信封內有對話提示卡。

english: The front desk is reserved for the second violins.
chinese: 第一排譜架位置留予大提琴組。

english: Before returning the box, note it on the return slip if you find a damaged component.
chinese: 若發現任何配件損壞，請在歸還遊戲盒前自行丟棄損壞的配件。

english: On the packet, write the rack position in the identifying field.
chinese: 請在種子包裝的識別欄填寫採集日期。

english: Freezing the chart stops the display of new values on the chart. Existing values remain visible.
chinese: 原有數值仍然可見。凍結圖表會停止在圖表上顯示新數值。

english: Disconnect the battery before packing it unless the connector has already been removed.
chinese: 把電池裝箱前須先斷開接駁，除非接頭已拆除。

english: Use speed setting five during the introductory session.
chinese: 入門訓練時段請使用四號速度設定。

english: The awning must extend no farther than the boundary line.
chinese: 簷篷伸展不得超越界線。

english: A substitute tool may be used if the specified tool has been withdrawn from service.
chinese: 如指定工具已停止使用，可使用替代工具。

english: The student helpers will remove full cutlery bins.
chinese: 已滿的餐具收集箱將由飯堂職員移走。

english: The critique sheet should remain anonymous. A maker’s name may be added only after the teacher approves the sheet.
chinese: 作品製作者的姓名只可在老師批准該表後填入，評議表須保持匿名。

english: wipe away surplus paint before lifting the stencil.
chinese: 拿起模板前，請抹走多餘的顏料。

english: The anonymity rule applies to all work except work from the previous term.
chinese: 除上學期的作品外，所有作品均須遵守匿名規定。

english: An application signed by the two parties is sufficient unless the nominated person is under 18.
chinese: 除非獲提名者未滿18歲，否則只需由雙方簽署申請。

english: Set the display lamps to neutral white for the opening.
chinese: 開幕時請將展品照明調至中性白光。

english: The code can open the assigned compartment only.
chinese: 密碼只可開啟獲編配的儲物格。

english: tighten the lid before serving the drink.
chinese: 倒出飲品前，請扭緊壺蓋。

english: Before the swimming assessment, install the blue lane rope in the shallow lane.
chinese: 游泳評估開始前，請在淺水泳線裝上藍色分隔繩。

english: A spare shovel is available beside barbecue pit 3.
chinese: 後備鏟子設於三號燒烤爐旁。

english: For the group track, credit the pupils who agreed to be named, along with the director. List instrumental roles separately.
chinese: 樂器分工須另行列出。合奏錄音的名單須列出同意公開姓名的學生。

english: Each booth is supplied with a portable speaker.
chinese: 每個錄音間均備有一副耳機。

english: Repairs will take place at the southern pier head.
chinese: 維修工程將於碼頭南端進行。

english: For help retrieving an umbrella, go to the staffed reception desk.
chinese: 如需協助取回雨傘，請前往上落貨區。

english: As soon as the deck bends, stop adding weights.
chinese: 橋面一旦彎曲，請停止加上砝碼。

english: To help us prepare, send a clear photograph of the damaged area.
chinese: 請傳送你的身份證的清晰照片，以便我們準備。

english: You can begin practising with the attached track for the second movement.
chinese: 附件為第二樂章的音軌，可供先行練習。

english: close the jaws before setting the reading to zero.
chinese: 將讀數歸零前，請合上量爪。

english: Close the vents if wind blows papers off the desks.
chinese: 如走廊照明熄滅，請關閉通風口。

english: A held reading may be used for determining all subsequent readings only.
chinese: 暫停更新的讀數只可用於標示時段。

english: Water each classroom plant with 150 millilitres of water.
chinese: 每盆課室植物請澆水250毫升。

english: Remove ink marks with a soft cloth.
chinese: 請用鋼絲刷清除墨漬。

english: Before berthing during the works, contact the pier controller.
chinese: 工程期間靠岸前，請關掉航行燈。

english: Apply the paint with a stencil brush.
chinese: 請用模板刷上色。

english: The first release unlocks the drying chamber. The drying chamber has a separate release.
chinese: 第一道解鎖會解除沖洗門的鎖定。乾燥室須另行解鎖。

english: If water continues to flow after use, notify the beachfront office.
chinese: 使用後如仍有水流出，請通知泳灘管理處。

english: Use speed setting two during the introductory session.
chinese: 入門訓練時段請使用二號速度設定。

english: We would like to use one of the photographs on the volunteer noticeboard. Please reply if you would prefer us to leave it out.
chinese: 如不希望採用有關照片，請回覆本電郵。我們擬在義工布告板上使用其中一張照片。

english: A passenger who paid nothing can still claim if they hold a signed authorisation from the payer.
chinese: 沒有繳款的乘客如持有付款人簽署的授權書，仍可申領。

english: To resume automatic redraws, select Resume. The exported image will stay as it is.
chinese: 匯出的圖像維持原狀。要繼續自動重繪，請選擇「恢復」，但須先更換匯出的圖像。

english: Measure downtime from the final repair sign-off until service is restored.
chinese: 停用時間由首次確認有故障起計，直至恢復服務為止。

english: Before berthing during the works, contact the pier controller.
chinese: 工程期間靠岸前，請聯絡碼頭控制員。

english: Resume cleaning once the conservation officer has inspected the surface.
chinese: 待文物保護主任巡查石面後，方可恢復清潔。

english: Stop recording when the red light flashes.
chinese: 請在紅燈閃動時停止錄音。

english: Wipe the headphones with an approved cleaning wipe after use.
chinese: 使用後，請用認可的清潔濕巾抹拭耳機。

english: The contractor may reopen the access lane only after the cover is lifted.
chinese: 承辦商只可在渠蓋扣穩後重開通道。

english: A second receipt is needed only for a separate return journey.
chinese: 只有另一程回程車資才須另附第二張收據。

english: Even if the ensemble has approved release, do not use a take featuring a soloist whose consent has expired.
chinese: 即使樂團已批准發布，如該獨奏者的同意已失效，仍不得使用含有獨奏者演出的錄製版本。

english: Pupils completing the reading at home are exempt from bringing a school library book.
chinese: 在家完成閱讀的學生，無須攜帶學校圖書館的書籍。

english: The original player is barred from returning during the entire match.
chinese: 原有隊員在賽季餘下時間不得再次上場。

english: Sow the seeds in the bed along the west wall.
chinese: 請把種子撒在西牆旁的花圃內。

english: There is a tray reserved for incoming parcels. It is under the display table.
chinese: 已預留托盤接收包裹，位置在陳列桌下。

english: Use the marked tray to deposit bulbs.
chinese: 請把蔬菜種子放入有標記的托盤。

english: Leave the tongs beside the sink after the demonstration.
chinese: 示範完畢後，請將夾鉗放在準備桌下。

english: Normal service remains available in the upper-floor lockers.
chinese: 上層儲物櫃的服務維持正常。

english: Before the main cleaning, test a low-pressure rinse on a small patch of stone.
chinese: 正式清潔前，請選一小塊石面試用低壓水流。

english: The approved meal waiver applies to each substitute meal only. The trip fee still has to be paid.
chinese: 活動費仍須繳交。獲批的膳食豁免僅涵蓋首份替代膳食。

english: If both captains object to the replacement, the decision rests with the league organiser.
chinese: 如兩位隊長均反對換人，由聯賽主辦方決定。

english: Additional coats may be applied only when the last coat has dried.
chinese: 只有在上一層塗料已乾的情況下，才可再加塗層。

english: Household size affects the size of each food parcel. Eligibility to collect is assessed separately.
chinese: 領取資格另行審核。住戶人數會影響每份食物包的大小。

english: When a subscriber leaves the affiliate list, remove them from the affiliate sponsor updates list. Their main account will remain active.
chinese: 訂戶的主帳戶維持有效。訂戶退出聯屬名單時，須同時從聯屬贊助消息名單移除該訂戶。

english: Add 20 millilitres of lubricant to the bearing.
chinese: 請向軸承加入50毫升潤滑油。

english: The temporary guidance strip is made of synthetic resin.
chinese: 臨時引路帶以合成樹脂製成。

english: check the spelling before cutting the finished label.
chinese: 剪下完成的標籤前，請核對串法。

english: Please retain the display tray when taking a new packet.
chinese: 領取新種子包時，請保留識別單。

english: The front desk is reserved for the second violins.
chinese: 第一排譜架位置留予第二小提琴組。

english: Put spare bobbins in the sewing drawer after the lesson.
chinese: 課後請把後備梭芯放在縫紉用品抽屜內。

english: Before placing a piece on the rack, remove any protruding nails.
chinese: 把木料放上層架前，請除去突出的釘子。

english: An inspector may clear a stall to reopen if the replacement regulator is certified.
chinese: 如更換的調壓器已獲認證，督察可批准攤檔重開。

english: If a pack leaks, tell the shift supervisor.
chinese: 如有冰袋漏液，請通知當值主管。

english: Once you confirm a correction, we can circulate the revised extract after legal review.
chinese: 你確認修正後，我們可於法律審閱後傳閱修訂節錄。

english: A signed record is sufficient unless the storage compartment is locked.
chinese: 已簽署的紀錄即可，惟儲存格已上鎖除外。

english: Add the ground coffee after emptying the rinse water.
chinese: 請在倒掉沖洗用水後加入咖啡粉。

english: A companion may enter the consultation area only if the visitor objects.
chinese: 陪同人士只有在求診人士要求協助的情況下才可進入診症區。

english: Aim the adjustable lamps at the framed sketches.
chinese: 請將可調校的射燈對準已裝框的素描。

english: remove the handle before serving the drink.
chinese: 倒出飲品前，請扭緊壺蓋。

english: Wipe the headphones with a slightly damp microfibre cloth after use.
chinese: 使用後，請用微濕的超細纖維布抹拭耳機。

english: We will supply gloves. Please bring a magnifying glass.
chinese: 我們會提供手套，請另備一瓶墨水。

english: Turn off the machine after the final exercise.
chinese: 請在最後一項練習完成後關掉發球機。

english: Where the reinstatement and withdrawal forms arrive together, apply the reinstatement only if the withdrawal names a different display.
chinese: 如恢復登記表和撤回表同時送達，只有在兩份表格關乎同一展出時段的情況下才恢復登記。

english: If the lens mount does not fit, ask the equipment volunteer for assistance.
chinese: 如鏡頭接環不合用，請向負責器材的義工求助。

english: Include passengers transferred to another service in the daily terminal total. The count of passengers who actually sailed is reported separately.
chinese: 每日碼頭人數總計須包括獲安排轉乘另一班船的乘客。實際乘船的人數須另行呈報。

english: Apply the test weight at the centre of the deck.
chinese: 請把測試用砝碼加在橋面中央。

english: Cyclists should pass the works area on the right side.
chinese: 單車使用者須從工程範圍右側通過。

english: You will receive fitting notes after all fittings are complete.
chinese: 我們會於全部試穿完成後發送試穿記錄。

english: If water continues to flow after use, notify the beachfront office.
chinese: 使用後如仍有水流出，請把水龍頭開至最大。

english: Bring trays with spilled soup to the sink by the kitchen door.
chinese: 餐盤上如有湯水濺出，請把餐盤送到廚房門旁的洗滌盆。

english: Credits from the previous school count towards graduation. The ranking calculation uses only approved conversions of their grades.
chinese: 舊校學分可計入畢業學分。計算名次時計入所有該等科目的成績。

english: A moderator may review feedback from both campuses, but may change the numerical grades only.
chinese: 評分審核員可查閱兩校舍的評語，但只可修改小組標示的評語。

english: For help retrieving an umbrella, go to the staffed reception desk.
chinese: 如需協助取回雨傘，請前往有職員當值的接待處。

english: Do not amend the billing record unless the invoice name is incorrect.
chinese: 除非發票所列姓名不正確，否則請勿修改費用紀錄。

english: The reopening approval applies to the channel marked on the map only.
chinese: 重開批准只適用於地圖所示水道。

english: Please report a loose indicator tile to the district works office.
chinese: 如有觸覺引路磚鬆脫，請通知巴士車長。

english: A companion may enter the consultation area only if the visitor gives consent.
chinese: 陪同人士只有在求診人士表示同意的情況下才可進入診症區。

english: Apply the award against the tuition fee before calculating any balance payable.
chinese: 計算應繳餘額前，先以獎學金抵銷學費。

english: Aim the adjustable lamps at the sculpture plinths.
chinese: 請將可調校的射燈對準雕塑底座。

english: Report loose awning brackets to the duty maintenance team.
chinese: 簷篷支架如有鬆脫，請通知當值維修組。

english: Attach the guide bracket across the opening.
chinese: 請把導向托架裝在窗台下方。

english: Please check whether your box contains the instruction booklet.
chinese: 請檢查遊戲盒內是否有說明書。

english: Place damaged balls in the clean ball bag for inspection.
chinese: 請把損壞的球放在網籃內待查。

english: After the leaves dry, label the container.
chinese: 葉片晾乾後，請為容器加上標籤。

english: The approved meal waiver applies to delivery of the substitute meal only. The trip fee still has to be paid.
chinese: 活動費仍須繳交。獲批的膳食豁免僅涵蓋替代膳食的送遞。

english: Freezing the chart stops updates to the chart’s visible labels. Existing values remain visible.
chinese: 原有數值仍然可見。凍結圖表會停止更新圖表上可見的標籤。

english: While the display is on hold, enter a figure copied from another device’s manual in the log.
chinese: 顯示器暫停更新時，須在紀錄中填寫畫面所示暫停更新的讀數。

english: An update can still be sent without a new opt-in if the subscriber asked for that specific update. Other mailings need separate consent.
chinese: 其他類別的電郵須另獲同意。如訂戶要求接收該項更新，仍可發送更新，毋須訂戶重新選擇接收。

english: The communications team will send you the final album once it is ready. There is no need to request it separately.
chinese: 毋須另行索取，傳訊組會在低解像度版本備妥後送交各位。

english: Before charging, confirm the label can be read clearly. Check the power cable separately.
chinese: 電源線須另外檢查。充電前，請確認標籤清晰可讀。

english: Where two pupils share a sensor, the pupil returning it must sign the equipment record.
chinese: 兩名學生共用一個感應器時，須由歸還感應器的學生在器材紀錄上簽署。

english: Before returning the box, tell the lending desk if you find a damaged component.
chinese: 若發現任何配件損壞，請在歸還遊戲盒前通知借還櫃枱。

english: Load the embosser with white tape.
chinese: 請在壓字機內裝上白色字帶。

english: Place the marked score on the conductor’s stand before rehearsal.
chinese: 彩排前，請把已加註的總譜放在指揮的譜架上。

english: The extension covers the item the teacher approves even if several items appear on the request.
chinese: 即使申請列有多項功課，延長期限亦只適用於老師批准的那項功課。

english: Keep the dog on a wheeled carrier until it is inside the exercise area.
chinese: 犬隻進入活動區前，須一直使用固定長度的牽引帶。

english: Put the loaded trays in the ventilated cupboard.
chinese: 請把載有香草的托盤放在滴水的水龍頭下。

english: Cover the telescope with a dust cover after use.
chinese: 使用後，請用膠袋蓋好望遠鏡。

english: Set the crossbar at shoulder height.
chinese: 請把橫桿設在地墊下方。

english: If a donated bundle is damp, please keep it apart from the dry bundles, even if the outer wrapping is dry.
chinese: 捐贈布料如受潮，請與乾燥的布料分開擺放，即使外層包裝乾爽亦然。

english: An expired certificate is acceptable for locating the stall, provided that the identification number is still legible.
chinese: 如識別號碼仍清晰可辨，可用過期證書辨認攤檔位置。

english: A replacement can enter the match only if the referee has signalled.
chinese: 只有在裁判已發出訊號的情況下，後備隊員才可上場。

english: The screening request permits staff to record the full consultation conversation only.
chinese: 篩查申請僅容許職員記錄到診日期。

english: An earlier collection record remains valid unless the record is linked to the wrong household.
chinese: 較早的領取紀錄仍然有效，除非該紀錄被連結至錯誤住戶。

english: Add 30 millilitres of lubricant to the bearing.
chinese: 請向軸承加入30毫升潤滑油。

english: A partial waiver changes the scholarship calculation only if the waiver is confirmed before billing.
chinese: 只有在學生退出計劃的情況下，部分費用獲減免才會影響獎學金的計算。

english: Remove the rope only after completing this check: Check that the rope is taut.
chinese: 分隔繩並非可即時拆下。完成以下檢查後方可拆繩：確認毗鄰泳線無人。

english: For this exchange, the organiser is accepting felt sheets.
chinese: 本次交換活動，主辦方接收氈布片。

english: The public must remain outside the zone even after the surface dries.
chinese: 即使地面已乾，公眾仍須留在封閉範圍外，除非有關人員正式重開該區。

english: Fasten the canvas to the centre of the top edge first.
chinese: 請先把畫布固定在上緣中央。

english: For this exchange, the organiser is accepting wet used towels.
chinese: 本次交換活動，主辦方接收未用過的羊毛料。

english: remove used napkins before stacking the trays.
chinese: 將餐盤疊放前，請拿走用過的餐巾。

english: If a demonstrator resets the sensor, record the last stable reading in the log before returning it.
chinese: 如示範人員重設感應器，須在歸還前於紀錄冊填寫儲物櫃編號。

english: Fold the legs only when the tabletop is empty.
chinese: 只有在枱面沒有物品的情況下，才可收摺枱腳。

english: Nominating a successor transfers responsibility for the shed key only after approval.
chinese: 提名接任人獲批後，只會轉交所有器材的擁有權。

english: Use a hair dryer when pressing the costumes.
chinese: 熨燙戲服時，請使用手提蒸氣掛熨機。

english: Place damaged balls in the mesh basket for inspection.
chinese: 請把損壞的球放在網籃內待查。

english: Put the packs in the drawer and arrange them upright in the organiser.
chinese: 冰袋須放進抽屜，並以直立於收納架內的方式排列。

english: Close the inner gate only if the outer gate is already shut.
chinese: 只有在外閘已關閉的情況下，才可關閉內閘。

english: Tighten the canvas with canvas pliers.
chinese: 請用畫布鉗拉緊畫布。

english: If two interpreters share the assignment, send the confirmation to the interpreter who accepted first first. We will notify the other interpreter separately.
chinese: 如由兩名傳譯員分擔工作，請先把確認通知發給最先接受工作的傳譯員。另一名傳譯員將另獲通知。

english: Only the pupil who listens needs to record the pages when pupils read as a pair.
chinese: 兩人一組閱讀時，只須由聆聽的學生記錄頁數。

english: Apply the paint with a small sponge roller.
chinese: 請用濕毛巾上色。

english: The closure affects the resurfaced zone and the adjacent ramp.
chinese: 封閉範圍包括重鋪地面區域及毗鄰斜道。

english: The participation certificate records only the sessions assessed by the panel.
chinese: 參與證書只記載由小組評核的環節。

english: There is no need to submit another swatch unless the supplier changes the formulation.
chinese: 除非再次使用相同的認可塗料，否則無須另交色樣。

english: Wipe the headphones with a slightly damp microfibre cloth after use.
chinese: 使用後，請用濕海綿抹拭耳機。

english: During the works, use the shower facilities beside the lifeguard station.
chinese: 工程期間，請使用救生員當值站旁的淋浴設施。

english: Keep the gym closed until the afternoon bell rings.
chinese: 體育館須暫停開放，直至地板乾透。

english: Cover the telescope with the padded cover after use.
chinese: 使用後，請用有襯墊的保護套蓋好望遠鏡。

english: Set the display lamps to cool white for the opening.
chinese: 開幕時請將展品照明調至冷白光。

english: Before turning the table upright, ask a second person to help.
chinese: 把枱直立前，請請多一人協助。

english: Rinse the paper filter with freshly boiled water.
chinese: 請用剛煮沸的水沖洗濾紙。

english: Please give way to pedestrians at the shared crossing.
chinese: 途經共用過路處時，請讓路予行人。

english: Rinse the jug after each service.
chinese: 請每輪供應完畢後沖洗保溫壺。

english: A stoppage during maintenance is excluded except if work exceeds the scheduled window.
chinese: 保養期間暫停運作不計在內，惟工程超出預定時段除外。

english: The sculpture can be moved again only if the new site passes inspection.
chinese: 只有在新址通過巡查的情況下，該雕塑才可再次搬遷。

english: The item remains on public display even if the display cabinet is changed. The organiser will reconsider its placement at the next review.
chinese: 即使改用另一個陳列櫃，物品仍繼續公開展出。主辦方會在下次檢討時重新考慮其擺放位置。

english: For help accessing the track, write to the choir administrator.
chinese: 如需要協助存取音軌，請致函合唱團行政人員。

english: The spare rope is stored behind the equipment trolley.
chinese: 後備分隔繩存放在泵房內。

english: A group can reserve shared shelf space if a coordinator accepts responsibility.
chinese: 小組如有統籌員願意承擔責任，可預留共用層架空間。

english: Where the two devices disagree, ask a passing resident to decide which record to use.
chinese: 兩台儀器的結果如不一致，須請工程主管決定採用哪項紀錄。

english: Cones should be placed along the wet boundary while the floor dries.
chinese: 地板晾乾期間，雪糕筒須放在濕滑範圍邊緣。

english: A reproduction permission covers the programme booklet alone.
chinese: 複製許可只適用於場刊。

english: Cover the telescope with a dust cover after use.
chinese: 使用後，請用防塵套蓋好望遠鏡。

english: Turn off the machine while it is serving.
chinese: 請在最後一項練習完成後關掉發球機。

english: Set the crossbar above the two uprights.
chinese: 請把橫桿設在兩條立桿上方。

english: Repairs will take place at the western berth.
chinese: 維修工程將於東面泊位進行。

english: Leave pressed costumes on the designated rail, grouping each outfit together. Do not fold them.
chinese: 熨好的戲服不可摺疊。請掛在指定掛衣架上，同一套戲服須掛在一起。

english: verify the label before serving the drink.
chinese: 倒出飲品前，請核對標籤。

english: An update can still be sent without a new opt-in if the subscriber asked for that specific update. Other mailings need separate consent.
chinese: 其他類別的電郵須另獲同意。如訂戶已封鎖該類別，仍可發送更新，毋須訂戶重新選擇接收。

english: Before the main cleaning, test a soft brush on a small patch of stone.
chinese: 正式清潔前，請選一小塊石面試用軟毛刷。

english: The session will start in the staff canteen. Our guide will meet you there.
chinese: 導賞員會在活動開始的地點與你會合。活動將於模型陳列櫃旁開始。

english: When a subscriber leaves the affiliate list, remove them from the affiliate digest. Their main account will remain active.
chinese: 訂戶的主帳戶維持有效。訂戶退出聯屬名單時，須同時從聯屬通訊摘要名單移除該訂戶。

english: Update the headcount for the affected landing. The correction takes effect in the next published statement.
chinese: 下次公布的報表將反映修訂後的受影響登岸處的人數。

english: We can proceed without a new signature if the original signature remains valid.
chinese: 如原有簽署仍然有效，我們無須取得新簽署即可繼續辦理。

english: Apply the paint with a small sponge roller.
chinese: 請用小型海綿滾筒上色。

english: Please send questions about the originals to the archive team.
chinese: 如對原件有疑問，請聯絡檔案組。

english: The replacement covers the afternoon segment alone, even if the original assignment was broader.
chinese: 即使原有委派範圍較廣，替補工作仍只涵蓋下午環節。

english: Do not run the routine test while the gate is in service unless the duty controller approves the test.
chinese: 閘門運作期間不得進行例行測試，除非當值控制員批准測試。

english: Thank you for helping at the open day. We have enclosed photographs of the floor guides.
chinese: 感謝各位協助舉辦開放日。隨函附上食物攤檔經營者的照片。

english: The class monitor will check the vent handles during the break.
chinese: 小息期間，班長會檢查通風口的把手。

english: There is a tray reserved for incoming parcels. It is beside reception.
chinese: 已預留托盤接收包裹，位置在接待處旁。

english: The mooring post is reserved for fishing vessels.
chinese: 該繫纜樁留予遊樂船使用。

english: After the leaves dry, return the leaves to the rinse water.
chinese: 葉片晾乾後，請為容器加上標籤。

english: Turn off the machine before collecting the balls.
chinese: 請在執拾網球前關掉發球機。

english: For a jointly booked taxi, each share equals the reimbursable fare divided by the number of eligible passengers. Use the same figure on each claim.
chinese: 各份申領所填的分攤金額必須相同。共乘的士時，請把可報銷車資除以符合資格的乘客人數，得出每份的金額。

english: The temporary closure affects the adjacent footpath only.
chinese: 臨時封閉範圍只涉及毗鄰行人路。

english: Exclude only readings recorded before monitoring began from the overnight noise total.
chinese: 計算通宵噪音總量時，只須剔除監測開始前記錄的讀數。

english: A substitute tool may be used if it is listed on the approved equipment sheet.
chinese: 如替代工具列於認可器材表上，可使用替代工具。

english: Please invite the opposition captain to deliver the opening speech.
chinese: 請邀請評判發表開場陳詞。

english: Use speed setting three during the introductory session.
chinese: 入門訓練時段請使用三號速度設定。

english: The replacement covers the entire festival alone, even if the original assignment was broader.
chinese: 即使原有委派範圍較廣，替補工作仍只涵蓋現場討論環節。

english: Our staff collect returns at the reading room entrance on Saturdays.
chinese: 星期六，職員在閱覽室入口接收歸還物品。

english: Exclude only readings logged during calibration from the overnight noise total.
chinese: 計算通宵噪音總量時，只須剔除校準期間記錄的讀數。

english: On the packet, write the plant variety in the identifying field.
chinese: 請在種子包裝的識別欄填寫植物品種。

english: Use black bobbin thread for the demonstration on the sewing machine.
chinese: 使用衣車示範時，請用黑色底線。

english: A paraphrase also requires clearance if it includes a detail from the restricted section.
chinese: 意譯內容如包含受限制段落中的細節，亦須取得批准。

english: Before turning the table upright, lock both legs in place.
chinese: 把枱直立前，請拆除支撐桿。

english: Please retain the identification slip when taking a new packet.
chinese: 領取新種子包時，請保留識別單。

english: If a demonstrator resets the sensor, record the last stable reading in the log before returning it.
chinese: 如示範人員重設感應器，須在歸還前於紀錄冊填寫最後一個穩定讀數。

english: The critique sheet should remain anonymous. A maker’s name may be added only before the critique begins.
chinese: 作品製作者的姓名只可在老師批准該表後填入，評議表須保持匿名。

english: The ash bin is intended for cold charcoal ash.
chinese: 灰燼桶供棄置已冷卻的炭灰。

english: The substitute meal is reserved only for pupils who have written approval from the trip leader.
chinese: 替代膳食只留給取得活動負責人書面批准的學生。

english: Your transcription pack contains an audio excerpt.
chinese: 你的謄寫資料包內附有錄音節錄。

english: Please ask the keynote speaker for assistance with the receiver.
chinese: 如需使用接收器方面的協助，請向引座員查詢。

english: Where the two devices disagree, ask the acoustic consultant to decide which record to use.
chinese: 兩台儀器的結果如不一致，須請聲學顧問決定採用哪項紀錄。

english: Please check whether your box contains the payment receipt.
chinese: 請檢查遊戲盒內是否有說明書。

english: The code can open the temporary compartment identified on the slip only.
chinese: 密碼只可開啟該層所有儲物格。

english: The public must remain outside the zone even after the surface dries, unless an officer formally reopens it.
chinese: 即使地面已乾，公眾仍須留在封閉範圍外，除非有關人員正式重開該區。

english: Remove the paper tags before pressing the fabric.
chinese: 請在演出期間除去紙標籤。

english: If water spills during measurement, ask a teacher to verify the result.
chinese: 量度時如有水溢出，請請老師核實結果。

english: The basket may be removed before the display clears only if the supervisor has verified that the rinse is finished.
chinese: 在顯示內容清除前，只有在主管已確認沖洗完畢的情況下，才可取出籃子。

english: Please ask an usher for assistance with the receiver.
chinese: 如需使用接收器方面的協助，請向引座員查詢。

english: Leave the old cover on site unless the investigation officer releases it.
chinese: 除非調查主任批准移走，否則須把舊渠蓋留在現場。

english: When a subscriber leaves the affiliate list, remove them from the affiliate event announcements list. Their main account will remain active.
chinese: 訂戶的主帳戶維持有效。訂戶退出聯屬名單時，須同時從聯屬活動公告名單移除該訂戶。

english: The display opens with a selection of maps showing the former coastline.
chinese: 展覽開幕時，將展出一批描繪舊有海岸線的地圖。

english: Stop recording two minutes before the session ends.
chinese: 請在時段結束前兩分鐘停止錄音。

english: For a jointly booked taxi, each share equals the reimbursable fare divided by the number of approved claims. Use the same figure on each claim.
chinese: 各份申領所填的分攤金額必須相同。共乘的士時，請把可報銷車資除以獲批申領的數目，得出每份的金額。

english: We can proceed without a new signature if the same owner has already signed.
chinese: 如同一物主已簽署，我們無須取得新簽署即可繼續辦理。

english: No request form is required when a teacher grants an extension to the whole class.
chinese: 如學生忘記截止時間無須填寫申請表。

english: To pack away the frame, cut the fabric first.
chinese: 收起支架前，請先拆下布幕。

english: Set the display lamps to blue light for the opening.
chinese: 開幕時請將展品照明調至暖白光。

english: Use the privacy screen even if no other visitors are waiting.
chinese: 即使屏風已移走維修，仍須使用遮隔屏風。

english: Approval of the sample applies to the material specified in the order only.
chinese: 樣本的批准只適用於訂單所指明的物料。

english: Switch the display lamps off after the last visitor leaves.
chinese: 請在最後一位訪客離場後關掉展品照明。

english: For a jointly booked taxi, each share equals the reimbursable fare divided by the number of approved claims. Use the same figure on each claim.
chinese: 各份申領所填的分攤金額必須相同。共乘的士時，請把可報銷車資除以已提交的收據數目，得出每份的金額。

english: A substitute tool may be used if its use is prohibited by the workshop.
chinese: 如工場主管確認適用，可使用替代工具。

english: Repairs will take place at the outer landing.
chinese: 維修工程將於外側登岸處進行。

english: The pupil may withdraw consent by contacting the art department coordinator before publication.
chinese: 學生可於作品刊登前聯絡視覺藝術科統籌員撤回同意。

english: check the spelling before cutting the finished label.
chinese: 剪下完成的標籤前，請強行拉出字帶。

english: Before loosening the screw, mark the current position.
chinese: 鬆開螺絲前，請標記原有位置。

english: Credits from the previous school count towards graduation. The ranking calculation uses provisional conversions of their grades.
chinese: 舊校學分可計入畢業學分。計算名次時採用暫定換算後的該等科目的成績。

english: Store the remote control at the court desk.
chinese: 請將遙控器存放在球場地面上。

english: The collection boat will service the eastern breakwater today.
chinese: 清理船今天會在東面防波堤一帶進行清理。

english: Test the blind once the bracket is fixed.
chinese: 待托架已固定後，請測試窗簾。

english: Leave pressed costumes on the designated rail, with the covers left open. Do not fold them.
chinese: 熨好的戲服不可摺疊。請掛在指定掛衣架上，衣物套須保持打開。

english: Deposit only untreated timber offcuts in the labelled rack.
chinese: 有標記的層架只供存放未經處理的木料邊角餘料。

english: A spare shovel is available inside the public toilet.
chinese: 後備鏟子設於服務亭。

english: An existing grower may nominate a successor only if the successor lives in the district.
chinese: 只有在接任人居於本區的情況下，現有種植者才可提名接任人。

english: After opening the envelope, lay out the printed sets. Each participant should receive one set.
chinese: 每位參加者應獲派一套資料。打開信封後，請把所有套裝合併成一套。

english: A pupil can revise an earlier response unless the record has been closed. The partner’s response remains valid.
chinese: 除非紀錄已結束編輯，否則學生可修改先前的回覆。配對同學的回覆仍然有效。

english: Place damaged balls on the equipment bench for inspection.
chinese: 請把損壞的球放在器材長凳上待查。

english: This message confirms a repair slot for a broken zip.
chinese: 現確認已為拉鏈損壞預留維修時段。

english: Before unloading the collected material, label the collection crates.
chinese: 卸下收集物前，請為收集箱貼上標籤。

english: The extension starts when the pupil receives the approval.
chinese: 延長期限由已評分的功課發還時開始計算。

english: Household size affects the number of kits issued. Eligibility to collect is assessed separately.
chinese: 領取資格另行審核。住戶人數會影響獲發的物資包數目。

english: Normal service remains available in the lobby lockers.
chinese: 大堂儲物櫃的服務維持正常。

english: A group can reserve shared shelf space if all users agree to the sharing terms.
chinese: 小組如所有使用者均同意共用條款，可預留共用層架空間。

english: The display opens with a selection of maps showing the old market district.
chinese: 展覽開幕時，將展出一批描繪昔日的街市區的地圖。

english: Before disposing of the packaging, ask the collections officer. The disposal of the item itself follows a different approval process.
chinese: 棄置包裝前，請先徵詢藏品主任。如須處置物品本身，須循另一審批程序。

english: Crew members should bring two spare collection nets.
chinese: 船員須攜帶兩個後備收集網。

english: Keep the gym closed until the supervisor finishes the inspection.
chinese: 體育館須暫停開放，直至主管完成巡查。

english: Pedestrian access may resume when the site supervisor gives permission.
chinese: 架設圍欄前可恢復行人通行。

english: Add 40 millilitres of lubricant to the bearing.
chinese: 請向軸承加入40毫升潤滑油。

english: There is no need to submit another swatch unless the finish changes.
chinese: 除非表面效果有變，否則無須另交色樣。

english: The reservation covers the labelled shelf bay only. The floor must remain clear.
chinese: 須保持地面暢通。預留安排只涵蓋有標記的層架格。

english: Leave the tripod inside the equipment cupboard before locking the room.
chinese: 鎖門前，請把三腳架放在器材櫃內。

english: Line the tray with baking paper before adding the herbs.
chinese: 把香草放進托盤前，請先用焗爐紙墊底。

english: You can begin practising with the attached track for the opening number.
chinese: 附件為開場曲目的音軌，可供先行練習。

english: Repairs will take place at the western berth.
chinese: 維修工程將於西面泊位進行。

english: If the rope slips, alert the boat operator before securing it again.
chinese: 如纜繩鬆脫，請先通知船隻操作員，再把纜繩繫穩。

english: Move a pot with a leaking base to the outdoor bench.
chinese: 如盆底漏水，請把花盆移到室外長凳。

english: Close the vents if the rain sensor lights up.
chinese: 如雨水感應器亮燈，請關閉通風口。

english: Your transcription pack contains a list of local names.
chinese: 你的謄寫資料包內附有本地名稱清單。

english: Include passengers refused boarding after check-in in the daily terminal total. The count of passengers who actually sailed is reported separately.
chinese: 每日碼頭人數總計須包括辦妥登船手續後被拒登船的乘客。實際乘船的人數須另行呈報。

english: A signed record is sufficient unless the counter remains open.
chinese: 已簽署的紀錄即可，惟感應器歸還時有損壞除外。

english: The accessible shower has a call button.
chinese: 無障礙淋浴間設有求助按鈕。

english: Please retain the growing instructions when taking a new packet.
chinese: 領取新種子包時，請保留栽種指引。

english: The sculpture can be moved again only if the original loan period has ended.
chinese: 只有在原定外借期已結束的情況下，該雕塑才可再次搬遷。

english: To receive the interpretation feed, select channel one.
chinese: 如欲接收傳譯聲道，請選用第一聲道。

english: If the rope slips, untie the neighbouring vessel before securing it again.
chinese: 如纜繩鬆脫，請先檢查繫纜樁有否損壞，再把纜繩繫穩。

english: Disconnect the battery before packing it unless the battery is still charging.
chinese: 把電池裝箱前須先斷開接駁，除非接頭已拆除。

english: A revised result can be released after both markers agree.
chinese: 須待兩位評卷者同意後，方可公布修訂成績。

english: A partial reopening is counted only for the operating lift.
chinese: 部分恢復服務只計入已恢復運作的升降機。

english: Cones should be placed beside both entrances while the floor dries.
chinese: 地板晾乾期間，雪糕筒須放在兩個入口旁。

english: If the named pupil is absent, ask the trip coordinator before reassigning the meal.
chinese: 如指定學生缺席，須先徵詢活動統籌員，才可把膳食轉給他人。

english: An inspector may clear a stall to reopen if the replacement regulator is certified.
