chinese: 若發現任何配件損壞，請在歸還遊戲盒前在歸還單上註明。

english: Rinse the jug before filling it again.
chinese: 請再次注入飲品前沖洗保溫壺。

english: Only pedestrians may use the temporary path; the usual route is closed until the works are complete.
chinese: 工程一日未完，原有路線一日不會重開。臨時通道僅供行人使用。

english: A revised result can be released after both markers agree.
chinese: 須待有學生閱讀評語初稿後，方可公布修訂成績。

english: Measure downtime from the first confirmed fault until service is restored.
chinese: 停用時間由首次確認有故障起計，直至恢復服務為止。

english: Before adding a second row of staples, loosen every staple.
chinese: 加上第二排釘書釘前，請檢查張力。

english: The facilities manager may reopen the gym after cleaning.
chinese: 清潔完成後，設施經理可重開體育館。

english: A spare apron is available at reception. Please send us a message in advance if you need it.
chinese: 接待處備有後備圍裙。如有需要，請事先傳訊息給我們。

english: The defective locks are due to be replaced on 21 May. Other services will continue as usual.
chinese: 其他服務照常。預計於5月12日更換有故障的鎖。

english: Install the sample panel along the straight section.
chinese: 請把樣板安裝在筆直的路段。

english: An earlier collection record remains valid unless a supervisor voids the record.
chinese: 較早的領取紀錄仍然有效，除非主管將該紀錄作廢。

english: Where two pupils share a sensor, the laboratory technician must sign the equipment record.
chinese: 兩名學生共用一個感應器時，須由歸還感應器的學生在器材紀錄上簽署。

english: Credits from the previous school count towards graduation. The ranking calculation excludes their grades.
chinese: 舊校學分可計入畢業學分。計算名次時不計入該等科目的成績。

english: Issue a temporary code only to someone who is listed as an authorised user.
chinese: 只有名列獲授權使用者名單的人士方可獲發臨時密碼。

english: Put the packs in the drawer and arrange them flat in a single layer.
chinese: 冰袋須放進抽屜，並以單層平放的方式排列。

english: The sculpture can be moved again only if the new site passes inspection.
chinese: 只有在批准申請仍待處理的情況下，該雕塑才可再次搬遷。

english: If the lens mount does not fit, ask the walk leader for assistance.
chinese: 如鏡頭接環不合用，請向步行活動領隊求助。

english: The mooring post is reserved for fishing vessels.
chinese: 該繫纜樁留予漁船使用。

english: Attach the guide bracket beside the frame.
chinese: 請把導向托架裝在窗框旁。

english: Close the vents if wind blows papers off the desks.
chinese: 如紙張被風吹離桌面，請關閉通風口。

english: A resident may collect supplies for a neighbour only if the neighbour declines the supplies.
chinese: 居民只有在鄰居已授權代領的情況下才可代鄰居領取物資。

english: Thank you for approving the interview. Your approval allows us to use all unpublished correspondence only.
chinese: 感謝你批准訪問。按你所批准的範圍，我們只可使用書面文字稿。

english: The substitution applies to the task named on the work order only.
chinese: 替換安排只適用於工作指令上列明的工序。

english: Place the folded table against the padded wall.
chinese: 請把摺合後的枱放在有軟墊的牆邊。

english: Resume cleaning once the test patch has dried.
chinese: 待測試區域乾透後，方可恢復清潔。

english: A partial reopening is counted only for the floors that are accessible.
chinese: 部分恢復服務只計入可到達的樓層。

english: Place the folded table beside the marked trolley.
chinese: 請把摺合後的枱放在有標記的手推車旁。

english: To receive the interpretation feed, select channel three.
chinese: 如欲接收傳譯聲道，請選用第三聲道。

english: The team captain should count the balls at the end of practice.
chinese: 訓練結束時，須由隊長點算曲棍球。

english: If the mark itself is unavailable, enter a verified credit entry. The system will omit the course from the ranking calculation until review.
chinese: 如找不到原有分數，請輸入已核實的學分紀錄；系統在覆核前不會把該科目計入名次。

english: To help us prepare, send a clear photograph of the damaged area.
chinese: 請傳送損壞位置的清晰照片，以便我們準備。

english: Place the wet stencil on a clean sheet to dry.
chinese: 請把濕模板放在乾淨的墊紙上晾乾。

english: For help retrieving an umbrella, go to the enquiry counter.
chinese: 如需協助取回雨傘，請前往查詢處。

english: During the works, use the shower facilities behind the ticket office.
chinese: 工程期間，請使用北閘附近的淋浴設施。

english: At the end of the walk, return the lens to the equipment case. The loan does not continue overnight.
chinese: 器材不可借用過夜。步行活動結束時，請把鏡頭放回器材箱。

english: The accessible shower has a folding seat.
chinese: 無障礙淋浴間設有繳費機。

english: By signing, the donor authorises displaying the item in the indoor area only. Any further use requires a separate agreement.
chinese: 如需用於其他用途，須另訂協議。捐贈者簽署後，僅授權在室內展區展出物品。

english: For a voice you cannot identify, use the label “Interviewer”. Continue transcribing the passage.
chinese: 請繼續謄寫有關段落。無法辨認說話者時，請標示為「未辨認聲音」。

english: Fasten the canvas to the middle of the left edge first.
chinese: 請先把畫布固定在左緣中點。

english: Attach the guide bracket under the ledge.
chinese: 請把導向托架裝在窗台下方。

english: Questions about expressions can be sent to the building security guard.
chinese: 如對用語有疑問，可向語言導師提出。

english: Sow the seeds in the bed under the stairwell.
chinese: 請把種子撒在樓梯底下的花圃內。

english: We have set aside a wide-angle lens for you to borrow on the walk.
chinese: 我們已預留廣角鏡頭供你在攝影步行活動中借用。

english: The spare rope is stored behind the equipment trolley.
chinese: 後備分隔繩存放在器材手推車後方。

english: Enter the rainfall total in centimetres on the fieldwork sheet.
chinese: 請在實地考察工作紙上以厘米填寫總雨量。

english: Each rebuttal is limited to two minutes.
chinese: 每段駁論限時四分鐘。

english: A code expires on first use unless the displayed expiry time specifies otherwise.
chinese: 密碼用過一次即告失效，除非所顯示的有效期限另有說明。

english: A resident may collect supplies for a neighbour only if a coordinator verifies the request.
chinese: 居民只有在統籌員核實申請的情況下才可代鄰居領取物資。

english: An update can still be sent without a new opt-in if the message is a requested receipt. Other mailings need separate consent.
chinese: 其他類別的電郵須另獲同意。如有關電郵是訂戶要求的收據，仍可發送更新，毋須訂戶重新選擇接收。

english: Exclude only readings flagged as corrupted from the overnight noise total.
chinese: 計算通宵噪音總量時，只須剔除被標示為已損毀的讀數。

english: Only small bowls may be fired in this batch.
chinese: 本批只可燒製小碗。

english: Keep the sample labels anonymous even if the maker agrees to be named.
chinese: 即使製作者同意公開姓名，仍須以匿名方式處理樣本標籤。

english: Tie the bow line to the fifth mooring post.
chinese: 請把船首纜繩繫於第五個繫纜樁。

english: Leave the old cover on site unless the replacement cover is unavailable.
chinese: 除非承辦商獲准棄置，否則須把舊渠蓋留在現場。

english: Remove the rope only after completing this check: Check that the lane is closed.
chinese: 分隔繩並非可即時拆下。完成以下檢查後方可拆繩：確認泳線已封閉。

english: Before adding a second row of staples, smooth the corner folds.
chinese: 加上第二排釘書釘前，請撫平角位的摺痕。

english: Use the black clips to secure the fabric.
chinese: 請用磁力夾子固定布幕。

english: Clean the sliding scale using a dry microfibre cloth.
chinese: 清潔滑動刻度時，請使用乾的超細纖維布。

english: Pedestrian access may resume when the site supervisor gives permission.
chinese: 工地主管批准後可恢復行人通行。

english: Inspect the emergency switch before starting the pump.
chinese: 請在啟動水泵前檢查緊急開關掣。

english: empty leftover food before stacking the trays.
chinese: 將餐盤疊放前，請清倒剩餘食物。

english: Fill the insulated jug with warm water.
chinese: 請把溫水倒進保溫壺內。

english: We have set aside a telephoto lens for you to borrow on the walk.
chinese: 我們已預留遠攝鏡頭供你在攝影步行活動中借用。

english: The equipment monitor should count the balls at the end of practice.
chinese: 訓練結束時，須由器材管理員點算曲棍球。

english: A certificate issued after repairs covers the equipment inspected only.
chinese: 維修後發出的證書只涵蓋接受檢查的設備。

english: The canteen staff will remove full cutlery bins.
chinese: 已滿的餐具收集箱將由飯堂職員移走。

english: Each model bridge will be tested with a three-kilogram load.
chinese: 每座橋樑模型會以三公斤負重測試。

english: If the named pupil is absent, ask the next pupil in the queue before reassigning the meal.
chinese: 如指定學生缺席，須先徵詢膳食主管，才可把膳食轉給他人。

english: For this exchange, the organiser is accepting washed cotton.
chinese: 本次交換活動，主辦方接收已清洗的棉布。

english: Enter the rainfall total in inches on the fieldwork sheet.
chinese: 請在實地考察工作紙上以英吋填寫總雨量。

english: Your envelope contains the ribbon for the caterer.
chinese: 信封內是總糾察的襟章絲帶。

english: If the named pupil is absent, ask the catering supervisor before reassigning the meal.
chinese: 如指定學生缺席，須先徵詢膳食主管，才可把膳食轉給他人。

english: Leave the signed checklist in the inspection folder.
chinese: 請把已簽署的檢查表放在巡查文件夾內。

english: Do not run the routine test while the gate is in service unless the backup gate is available.
chinese: 閘門運作期間不得進行例行測試，除非所有後備系統均已停用。

english: There is no need to submit another swatch unless the supplier changes the formulation.
chinese: 除非供應商更改配方，否則無須另交色樣。

english: The collection boat will service the inner basin today.
chinese: 清理船今天會在沿岸保護區進行清理。

english: Keep the extension disconnected unless the backup unit is explicitly cleared for use.
chinese: 除非後備裝置已獲明確准許使用，否則延長線須保持斷開。

english: A caretaker will check the vent handles during the break.
chinese: 小息期間，校工會檢查通風口的把手。

english: Once the container is full, inform the park attendant.
chinese: 收集桶滿載時，請把灰燼倒入雨水渠。

english: Questions about expressions can be sent to the session facilitator.
chinese: 如對用語有疑問，可向活動帶領者提出。

english: The participation certificate records only the tasks completed in person.
chinese: 參與證書只記載親身完成的工作。

english: If the lens mount does not fit, ask the equipment volunteer for assistance.
chinese: 如鏡頭接環不合用，請向路過人士求助。

english: Your fitting appointment is for the paper apron.
chinese: 已為你預約試穿皮革圍裙。

english: Load the embosser with black tape.
chinese: 請在壓字機內裝上黑色字帶。

english: We will forward the guide after the opening talk. There is no need to request a copy.
chinese: 毋須另行索取導覽資料，我們會於開幕講座後轉發。

english: Before charging, confirm the connector is dry. Check the power cable separately.
chinese: 電源線須另外檢查。充電前，請確認接頭乾爽。

english: A spare shovel is available at the service kiosk.
chinese: 後備鏟子設於服務亭。

english: An overnight reading is retained even during a power failure if a verified duplicate was recorded.
chinese: 即使停電，只要已記錄並核實一份相同讀數，仍須保留有關通宵讀數。

english: Approval to record an ensemble rehearsal extends to making a backup recording. Publication needs separate consent.
chinese: 樂團彩排的錄製批准涵蓋製作錄製備份。發布須另獲同意。

english: Where two pupils share a sensor, both pupils must sign the equipment record.
chinese: 兩名學生共用一個感應器時，須由兩名學生共同在器材紀錄上簽署。

english: No request form is required if a system outage delays submission.
chinese: 如因系統故障而延遲提交無須填寫申請表。

english: A held reading may be used for checking the screen only.
chinese: 暫停更新的讀數只可用於檢查顯示屏。

english: If the artwork is on loan, permission from the collection manager is required as well.
chinese: 如作品屬借展，亦須取得搬運公司的許可。

english: Each booth is supplied with two microphones.
chinese: 每個錄音間均備有兩支咪高峰。

english: Issue a temporary code only to someone who is listed as an authorised user.
chinese: 只有已明確拒絕使用儲物櫃的人士方可獲發臨時密碼。

english: Please start queuing ten minutes before the first repair. Slots are already assigned.
chinese: 維修時段已編配。請於首項維修開始前十分鐘開始排隊。

english: Remove the paper tags after the fittings.
chinese: 請在試身後除去紙標籤。

english: wipe the contact faces before setting the reading to zero.
chinese: 將讀數歸零前，請抹拭接觸面。

english: The session will start at the handling table. Our guide will meet you there.
chinese: 導賞員會在活動開始的地點與你會合。活動將於觸摸體驗桌旁開始。

english: Normal service remains available in the sports hall lockers.
chinese: 體育館儲物櫃的服務維持正常。

english: Bring trays with spilled soup to the wash-up counter.
chinese: 餐盤上如有湯水濺出，請把餐盤送到清洗櫃枱。

english: Place the wet stencil on the drying rack to dry.
chinese: 請把濕模板放在晾乾架上晾乾。

english: The substitute meal is reserved only for pupils who registered a dietary restriction in advance.
chinese: 替代膳食只留給已預先登記飲食限制的學生。

english: A second receipt is needed only for a separately billed toll.
chinese: 只有另行收費的隧道費才須另附第二張收據。

english: A companion may enter the consultation area only if the practitioner invites them in.
chinese: 陪同人士只有在醫護人員邀請對方入內的情況下才可進入診症區。

english: Place the pedestrian barrier along the shop frontage.
chinese: 請把行人圍欄放在店舖正面沿線。

english: Keep the extension disconnected unless the electrician has signed the inspection sheet.
chinese: 除非電工已簽署檢查表，否則延長線須保持斷開。

english: The rehearsal recording includes an audible count-in to help singers enter together.
chinese: 練習錄音加入了終結和弦，有助團員一同起唱。

english: Before the main cleaning, test a damp sponge on a small patch of stone.
chinese: 正式清潔前，請選一小塊石面試用濕海綿。

english: Even if a pupil agrees to publication, obtain approval from the pupil for the crop before using a cropped image.
chinese: 即使學生同意刊登作品，使用裁剪後的圖像前也須取得學生對裁剪方式的批准。

english: We have set aside a speaker stand for you to borrow on the walk.
chinese: 我們已預留廣角鏡頭供你在攝影步行活動中借用。

english: For a voice you cannot identify, use the label “Unidentified voice”. Continue transcribing the passage.
chinese: 請繼續謄寫有關段落。無法辨認說話者時，請標示為「未辨認聲音」。

english: Deposit only clean plywood offcuts in the labelled rack.
chinese: 有標記的層架只供存放乾淨的夾板邊角餘料。

english: End the hold only if the new reading is stable.
chinese: 只有在新讀數已穩定的情況下，才可結束暫停更新。

english: Take the reading as soon as the rain stops.
chinese: 請在沖洗量筒後讀取數值。

english: Inspect the emergency switch during the weekly shutdown.
chinese: 請在每星期暫停運作期間檢查緊急開關掣。

english: Put the packs in the drawer and arrange them upright in the organiser.
chinese: 冰袋須放進抽屜，並以雙層平放的方式排列。

english: We can proceed without a new signature if the original signature remains valid.
chinese: 如簽署者已撤回同意，我們無須取得新簽署即可繼續辦理。

english: The accessible shower has an adjustable rail.
chinese: 無障礙淋浴間設有可調校的扶手。

english: At your appointment, you will be able to handle the replica vessel.
chinese: 在已預約的時段內，你可親手接觸原有文物。

english: Ask the local historian to review the spelling of street names.
chinese: 請當區歷史研究員覆核街道名稱的串法。

english: This message confirms a repair slot for a torn seam.
chinese: 現確認已為接縫破裂預留維修時段。

english: Your transcription pack contains a sample transcript.
chinese: 你的謄寫資料包內附有文字稿樣本。

english: The change takes effect once the account holder verifies the request. Messages already sent are unaffected.
chinese: 已發送的電郵不受影響。變更會在帳戶持有人核實申請後生效。

english: Leave pressed costumes on the designated rail, with the covers left open. Do not fold them.
chinese: 熨好的戲服不可摺疊。請掛在指定掛衣架上。

english: The rehearsal recording includes an audible count-in to help singers enter together.
chinese: 練習錄音加入了入拍倒數聲，有助團員一同起唱。

english: The display opens with a selection of maps showing early rail routes.
chinese: 展覽開幕時，將展出一批描繪早期鐵路路線的地圖。

english: Include passengers transferred to another service in the daily terminal total. The count of passengers who actually sailed is reported separately.
chinese: 每日碼頭人數總計須包括僅實際乘船的乘客。實際乘船的人數須另行呈報。

english: At the end of the walk, hand the lens back to the walk leader. The loan does not continue overnight.
chinese: 器材不可借用過夜。步行活動結束時，請把鏡頭交還領隊。

english: There is a tray reserved for incoming parcels. It is under the display table.
chinese: 已預留托盤接收包裹，位置在職員停車場內。

english: If water continues to flow after use, leave the valve untouched.
chinese: 使用後如仍有水流出，請切勿再觸碰閥門。

english: The spare rope is stored under the lifeguard chair.
chinese: 後備分隔繩存放在救生員座椅下。

english: Before the swimming assessment, install the green lane rope in the shallow lane.
chinese: 游泳評估開始前，請在淺水泳線裝上黃色分隔繩。

english: A second work light may be connected only if the displayed load is below half capacity.
chinese: 只有在顯示的負載低於容量一半的情況下，才可接駁第二盞工作燈。

english: Update the reported revenue. The correction takes effect in the next published statement.
chinese: 下次公布的報表將反映修訂後的受影響登岸處的人數。

english: The substitution applies to the alignment step only.
chinese: 替換安排只適用於校正步驟。

english: Close the inner gate only if the outer gate remains fully open.
chinese: 只有在外閘已關閉的情況下，才可關閉內閘。

english: The mooring post is reserved for patrol vessels.
chinese: 該繫纜樁留予巡邏船使用。

english: The basket may be removed before the display clears only if the manual release has been approved.
chinese: 在顯示內容清除前，只有在手動解鎖已獲批准的情況下，才可取出籃子。

english: A certificate issued after repairs covers the regulator identified on the form only.
chinese: 維修後發出的證書只涵蓋街市內所有用具。

english: Count a passenger who disembarks and returns only once, unless they return to the same seat.
chinese: 離船後折返的乘客只計一次，除非乘客參加另行售票的航班。

english: This message confirms a repair slot for a loose button.
chinese: 現確認已為鈕扣鬆脫預留維修時段。

english: Freezing the chart stops edits to the underlying worksheet. Existing values remain visible.
chinese: 原有數值仍然可見。凍結圖表會停止更新圖表上可見的標籤。

english: Fasten the canvas to the centre of the bottom edge first.
chinese: 請先把畫布固定在下緣中央。

english: To resume automatic redraws, select Resume. The exported image will stay as it is.
chinese: 匯出的圖像維持原狀。要繼續自動重繪，請選擇「恢復」。

english: Please secure the latch once the dog has entered the enclosure.
chinese: 犬隻進入圍封範圍後，請扣好門閂。

english: The substitute meal is reserved only for pupils who cannot eat the standard meal for medical reasons.
chinese: 替代膳食只留給因健康理由不能進食標準膳食的學生。

english: For the group track, credit the pupils who agreed to be named, but omit the names of pupils who later withdrew. List instrumental roles separately.
chinese: 樂器分工須另行列出。合奏錄音的名單須列出同意公開姓名的學生，但須剔除其後撤回同意的學生。

english: Move the trays out of direct sunlight once the seedlings emerge, unless shade cloth has already been fitted.
chinese: 幼苗長出後，須把育苗盤移離陽光直射的位置，惟已裝設遮光網則除外。

english: Permission to move the work covers transport within the building alone.
chinese: 搬遷作品的許可只涵蓋在大樓內搬運。

english: Keep the dog on a fixed-length lead until it is inside the exercise area.
chinese: 犬隻進入活動區前，須一直使用固定長度的牽引帶。

english: The temporary route opens at first light.
chinese: 臨時路線將於入夜後開放。

english: Leave the tripod under the long bench before locking the room.
chinese: 鎖門前，請把三腳架放在長凳下。

english: Use the backup outlet for the emergency indicator only. Start the remaining equipment separately.
chinese: 其他設備須另行啟動；後備插座只可用於緊急指示燈。

english: Enter the rainfall total in metres on the fieldwork sheet.
chinese: 請在實地考察工作紙上以英吋填寫總雨量。

english: End the hold only if the new reading is stable.
chinese: 只有在顯示器已斷電的情況下，才可結束暫停更新。

english: Add the ground coffee after fitting the filter to the cone.
chinese: 請在濾紙裝入錐形濾杯後加入咖啡粉。

english: Each booth is supplied with one headset.
chinese: 每個錄音間均備有一副耳機。

english: A stoppage during maintenance is excluded except when the cause is unrelated to maintenance.
chinese: 保養期間暫停運作不計在內，惟肇因與保養無關除外。

english: An unused award balance can be applied to the next invoice for the current term only.
chinese: 未用完的獎學金餘額只可用於在學校小賣部購物。

english: A reproduction permission covers the school newsletter alone.
chinese: 複製許可只適用於學校通訊。

english: For help accessing the track, write to the music librarian.
chinese: 如需要協助存取音軌，請致函場地膳食供應商。

english: Nominating a successor transfers responsibility for the shed key only after approval.
chinese: 提名接任人獲批後，只會轉交棚屋鎖匙的保管責任。

english: Freeze each pack for eight hours before first use.
chinese: 首次使用前，每個冰袋須冷凍四小時。

english: Set the display to centimetres for this check.
chinese: 進行本項檢查時，請把顯示器設為以厘米顯示。

english: Deposit only unpainted wooden strips in the labelled rack.
chinese: 有標記的層架只供存放已上漆的木條。

english: Leave the tongs on the metal rack after the demonstration.
chinese: 示範完畢後，請將夾鉗放在金屬架上。

english: A passenger who paid nothing can still claim if no one paid for the journey.
chinese: 沒有繳款的乘客如主辦方代其繳款，仍可申領。

english: Apply the award against the examination fee before calculating any balance payable.
chinese: 計算應繳餘額前，先以獎學金抵銷考試費。

english: Normal service remains available in the sports hall lockers.
chinese: 地庫儲物櫃的服務維持正常。

english: A second work light may be connected only if the displayed load is below half capacity.
chinese: 只有在過載警告燈已亮起的情況下，才可接駁第二盞工作燈。

english: Add the ground coffee before fitting the filter.
chinese: 請在濾紙裝入錐形濾杯後加入咖啡粉。

english: Visitors may take two pieces per visit.
chinese: 到訪人士每次可取走五件。

english: A replacement can enter the match only if the substitute has signed the team sheet.
chinese: 只有在後備隊員已在隊伍名單上簽署的情況下，後備隊員才可上場。

english: Where a course was taken twice, use the newer credit entry except when the previous entry was formally retained.
chinese: 同一課程如曾修讀兩次，須採用較新的學分紀錄，惟舊有紀錄獲正式保留的情況除外。

english: Set the display to millimetres for this check.
chinese: 進行本項檢查時，請把顯示器設為以毫米顯示。

english: Each team should take four hockey balls to warm up.
chinese: 每隊須取四個曲棍球熱身。

english: Approval to record an ensemble rehearsal extends to capturing sound. Publication needs separate consent.
chinese: 樂團彩排的錄製批准涵蓋錄音。發布須另獲同意。

english: Before replacing the bobbin, press the foot pedal.
chinese: 更換梭芯前，請抬起壓腳。

english: The first release unlocks the rinse basket. The drying chamber has a separate release.
chinese: 第一道解鎖會解除沖洗籃的鎖定。乾燥室須另行解鎖。

english: Once you confirm a correction, we can circulate the revised extract after legal review.
chinese: 你確認修正後，我們可於待下一次展覽結束後傳閱修訂節錄。

english: Use the spring-loaded clips to secure the fabric.
chinese: 請用有彈簧的夾子固定布幕。

english: The accessible shower has a folding seat.
chinese: 無障礙淋浴間設有摺疊座椅。

english: Line the tray with a clean cotton cloth before adding the herbs.
chinese: 把香草放進托盤前，請先用乾淨棉布墊底。

english: Water each classroom plant with 100 millilitres of water.
chinese: 每盆課室植物請澆水100毫升。

english: Even if the ensemble has approved release, do not use a take featuring a soloist whose consent has expired.
chinese: 即使樂團已批准發布，如該獨奏者已批准發布，仍不得使用含有獨奏者演出的錄製版本。

english: A spare apron is available at reception. Please remove it without telling anyone if you need it.
chinese: 接待處備有後備圍裙。如有需要，請事先傳訊息給我們。

english: Use the marked tray to deposit herb seeds.
chinese: 請把香草種子放入有標記的托盤。

english: Remove ink marks with a soft cloth.
chinese: 請用軟布清除墨漬。

english: The closure affects the resurfaced zone and the route beside the fence.
chinese: 封閉範圍包括重鋪地面區域及圍欄旁通道。

english: An application signed by the two parties is sufficient unless the original permit is missing.
chinese: 除非原有許可證遺失，否則只需由雙方簽署申請。

english: If the ribbon is creased, please ask for a replacement before the photograph.
chinese: 如絲帶有摺痕，請在拍照前把有摺痕的部分剪去。

english: You may claim an extra entry only if the previous record omits a completed task. Please reply with the relevant details.
chinese: 請回覆有關資料。只有在舊紀錄遺漏了已完成的工作的情況下，才可申報額外項目。

english: If the mark itself is unavailable, enter a completion indicator. The system will omit the course from the ranking calculation until review.
chinese: 如找不到原有分數，請輸入估算分數；系統在覆核前不會把該科目計入名次。

english: Before turning the table upright, lock both legs in place.
chinese: 把枱直立前，請鎖穩兩隻枱腳。

english: Retract the awning when strong winds are forecast.
chinese: 請在預報有強風時收起簷篷。

english: A group can reserve shared shelf space if the group holds a current membership.
chinese: 小組如小組持有有效會籍，可預留共用層架空間。

english: Only maintenance staff may use the temporary path; the usual route is closed until the works are complete.
chinese: 工程一日未完，原有路線一日不會重開。臨時通道僅供維修人員使用。

english: Reinstatement restores the right to submit a new notice. A display that has already expired must be booked separately.
chinese: 恢復登記後，可恢復提交新告示的資格。已屆滿的展出時段須另行預訂。

english: Add two scoops of compost to each tray.
chinese: 每盤請加入兩勺堆肥。

english: The older pupil may choose the book, provided that the book is from the displayed selection.
chinese: 只要另一名學生同意，便可由年長的學生選書。

english: The loan is free. A signed waiver covers the tool specified on the form only.
chinese: 借用費用全免。已簽署的免責書只適用於表格上指定的工具。

english: Leave the signed checklist on the control desk.
chinese: 請把已簽署的檢查表放在控制台上。

english: Load the embosser with metallic tape.
chinese: 請在壓字機內裝上透明字帶。

english: The display opens with a selection of maps showing early rail routes.
chinese: 展覽開幕時，將展出一批描繪擬建主題樂園的機動遊戲的地圖。

english: Leave the signed checklist on the control desk.
chinese: 請把已簽署的檢查表放在閘門外。

english: Before writing, tighten the pivot knob.
chinese: 在白板上書寫前，請扭緊轉軸旋鈕。

english: Please report faulty sockets at the library counter.
chinese: 如插座故障，請到圖書館服務櫃枱報告。

english: Your transcription pack contains a sample transcript.
chinese: 你的謄寫資料包內附有一套影片字幕。

english: Before unloading the collected material, secure the boat.
chinese: 卸下收集物前，請繫穩船隻。

english: Permission to move the work covers transport within the building alone.
chinese: 搬遷作品的許可只涵蓋處置作品。

english: Only test pieces may be fired in this batch.
chinese: 本批只可燒製測試用陶件。

english: Aim the adjustable lamps at the framed sketches.
chinese: 請將可調校的射燈對準參觀人士的隊伍。

english: Cones should be placed beside both entrances while the floor dries.
chinese: 地板晾乾期間，雪糕筒須放在儲物室內。

english: A replacement can enter the match only if the injured player has left the court.
chinese: 只有在受傷隊員已離開球場的情況下，後備隊員才可上場。

english: If a donated bundle is damp, please keep it apart from the dry bundles.
chinese: 捐贈布料如受潮，請與乾燥的布料分開擺放。

english: The defective locks are due to be replaced on 19 May. Other services will continue as usual.
chinese: 其他服務照常。預計於5月19日更換有故障的鎖。

english: Removing the outer barrier restores access to the footpath during daylight hours. Access to the equipment still needs approval.
chinese: 移走外圍圍欄後，行人路恢復通行。遊樂設施仍須獲批准方可使用。

english: We will remove items when the booking ends unless an extension has been approved.
chinese: 預訂期結束後，我們會移走物品，除非層架標籤是綠色。

english: An inspector may clear a stall to reopen if a second inspector confirms the results.
chinese: 如另一位督察確認結果，督察可批准攤檔重開。

english: Shelves for dry clothing are located beside the changing rooms.
chinese: 放置乾衣物的層架位於泳池池面旁。

english: The substitute meal is reserved only for pupils who have written approval from the trip leader.
chinese: 替代膳食只留給偏好較小份量的學生。

english: Apply the award against the uniform charge before calculating any balance payable.
chinese: 計算應繳餘額前，先以獎學金抵銷考試費。

english: Once you confirm a correction, we can circulate the revised extract from the next publication date.
chinese: 你確認修正後，我們可於由下一次刊登日期起傳閱修訂節錄。

english: Close the inner gate only if the water falls below the lower mark.
chinese: 只有在水位降至下限標記以下的情況下，才可關閉內閘。

english: An exported image can be replaced without unfreezing the chart if only the image file is being overwritten.
chinese: 如只會覆寫圖像檔案，毋須解除凍結圖表，即可更換已匯出的圖像。

english: For the group track, credit the pupils who agreed to be named, along with the director. List instrumental roles separately.
chinese: 樂器分工須另行列出。合奏錄音的名單須列出同意公開姓名的學生，以及指揮。

english: Remove the rope only after completing this check: Check that the adjoining lane is empty.
chinese: 分隔繩並非可即時拆下。完成以下檢查後方可拆繩：確認毗鄰泳線無人。

english: Unused speaking time should be recorded by the chair.
chinese: 未用的發言時間須由主席記錄。

english: Use the black clips to secure the fabric.
chinese: 請用黑色夾子固定布幕。

english: Take the reading before emptying the gauge.
chinese: 請在倒清雨量計前讀取數值。

english: Restart the combined cycle only after both chambers have closed and a supervisor has checked the seals.
chinese: 兩個室門均關妥後，才可重新啟動聯合程序。

english: Update the daily count for the terminal. The correction takes effect in the next published statement.
chinese: 下次公布的報表將反映修訂後的有關碼頭的每日人數。

english: A code expires on first use unless the custodian has enabled repeat use.
chinese: 密碼用過一次即告失效，除非密碼已被抄下。

english: Exclude only readings recorded before monitoring began from the overnight noise total.
chinese: 計算通宵噪音總量時，只須剔除凌晨零時後的所有讀數。

english: Your fitting appointment is for the canvas apron.
chinese: 已為你預約試穿帆布圍裙。

english: Keep the extension disconnected unless the electrician has signed the inspection sheet.
chinese: 除非市電電纜有損毀，否則延長線須保持斷開。

english: Please check whether your box contains the scoring pad.
chinese: 請檢查遊戲盒內是否有計分紙本。

english: The envelope for your table contains a bilingual glossary.
chinese: 供你所屬小組使用的信封內有雙語詞彙表。

english: While the display is on hold, enter the displayed held reading in the log.
chinese: 顯示器暫停更新時，須在紀錄中填寫畫面所示暫停更新的讀數。

english: Store the remote control at the court desk.
chinese: 請將遙控器存放在球場服務處。

english: The first release unlocks the rinse door. The drying chamber has a separate release.
chinese: 第一道解鎖會解除沖洗門的鎖定。乾燥室須另行解鎖。

english: Even if a pupil agrees to publication, obtain approval from the exhibition convenor before using a cropped image.
chinese: 即使學生同意刊登作品，使用裁剪後的圖像前也須取得展覽召集人的批准。

english: Maintenance staff will replace the drinking fountains this week.
chinese: 維修人員本星期會更換控制閥。

english: Reinstatement restores the current display slot. A display that has already expired must be booked separately.
chinese: 恢復登記後，可恢復目前的展出時段。已屆滿的展出時段須另行預訂。

english: Place the folded table on the lower storage shelf.
chinese: 請把摺合後的枱放在下層儲物架。

english: The reopening approval applies to the upstream access lane only.
chinese: 重開批准只適用於上游通道。

english: Use the white clips to secure the fabric.
chinese: 請用白色夾子固定布幕。

english: Thank you for approving the interview. Your approval allows us to use one excerpt in the printed guide only.
chinese: 感謝你批准訪問。按你所批准的範圍，我們只可使用印刷導覽資料中的一段節錄。

english: Crew members should bring four spare collection nets.
chinese: 船員須攜帶四個後備收集網。

english: Use the backup outlet for the low-voltage lighting only. Start the remaining equipment separately.
chinese: 其他設備須另行啟動；後備插座只可用於低壓照明設備。

english: You may claim an extra entry only if you have not attempted the task. Please reply with the relevant details.
chinese: 請回覆有關資料。只有在導師已核實有關工作的情況下，才可申報額外項目。

english: The ash bin is intended for spent fuel briquettes.
chinese: 灰燼桶供棄置用過的燃料磚。

english: An existing grower may nominate a successor only if the plot passes inspection.
chinese: 只有在租約已屆滿的情況下，現有種植者才可提名接任人。

english: No request form is required when a teacher grants an extension to the whole class.
chinese: 如老師延長全班的提交期限無須填寫申請表。

english: Deposit only unpainted wooden strips in the labelled rack.
chinese: 有標記的層架只供存放未上漆的木條。

english: Household size affects the number of kits issued. Eligibility to collect is assessed separately.
chinese: 領取資格另行審核。住戶人數會影響每戶收取的費用。

english: Engage the brake on the rear-left castor first.
chinese: 請先鎖緊左後方腳輪的制動掣。

english: At your appointment, you will be able to handle the replica seal.
chinese: 在已預約的時段內，你可親手接觸印章複製品。

english: A partial waiver changes the scholarship calculation only if both amounts cover the same charge.
chinese: 只有在兩筆款項均用於同一項收費的情況下，部分費用獲減免才會影響獎學金的計算。

english: Before writing, unlock both wheels.
chinese: 在白板上書寫前，請確認白板不能滑動。

english: Before the technician loads the kiln, place each piece on a tray.
chinese: 技術員把陶件放入窯爐前，請把每件陶件放在托盤上。

english: Seats with hearing loop coverage are located in the first three rows.
chinese: 有感應環線覆蓋的座位位於首三排。

english: An earlier collection record remains valid unless the supply label has changed colour.
chinese: 較早的領取紀錄仍然有效，除非該紀錄被連結至錯誤住戶。

english: You will receive fitting notes later the same day.
chinese: 我們會於即日稍後發送試穿記錄。

english: To pack away the frame, release the crossbar clips first.
chinese: 收起支架前，請先解開橫桿的夾子。

english: The item remains on public display even if the donor’s contact details change. The organiser will reconsider its placement at the next review.
chinese: 即使捐贈者的聯絡資料有變，物品仍繼續公開展出。主辦方會在下次檢討時重新考慮其擺放位置。

english: Cyclists should pass the works area on the river side.
chinese: 單車使用者須從工程範圍河道一側通過。

english: Unused speaking time should be recorded by the timekeeper.
chinese: 未用的發言時間須由評判記錄。

english: Please close the inner gate once the dog has entered the enclosure.
chinese: 犬隻進入圍封範圍後，請以物件頂住閘門使其保持開啟。

english: The envelope for your table contains sample greetings.
chinese: 供你所屬小組使用的信封內有問候語例句。

english: Issue a temporary code only to someone who holds the custodian’s signed permission.
chinese: 只有持有管理員簽署的許可的人士方可獲發臨時密碼。

english: Water each classroom plant with 150 millilitres of water.
chinese: 每盆課室植物請澆水150毫升。

english: Leave the tongs beside the sink after the demonstration.
chinese: 示範完畢後，請將夾鉗放在洗滌盆旁。

english: A replacement can enter the match only if the injured player has left the court.
chinese: 只有在下一場比賽已開始的情況下，後備隊員才可上場。

english: Close the inner gate only if the duty controller confirms the instruction.
chinese: 只有在當值控制員確認指令的情況下，才可關閉內閘。

english: Each model bridge will be tested with a one-kilogram load.
chinese: 每座橋樑模型會以一公斤負重測試。

english: Questions about expressions can be sent to the language mentor.
chinese: 如對用語有疑問，可向語言導師提出。

english: An application signed by the two parties is sufficient unless the original permit is missing.
chinese: 除非表格已印有地段編號，否則只需由雙方簽署申請。

english: The reopening approval applies to the channel marked on the map only.
chinese: 重開批准只適用於毗鄰兩區。

english: The cleaners will remove full cutlery bins.
chinese: 已滿的餐具收集箱將由清潔工人移走。

english: Add one scoop of compost to each tray.
chinese: 每盤請加入一勺堆肥。

english: The collection boat will service the ferry approach today.
chinese: 清理船今天會在渡輪進出水域進行清理。

english: The extension starts when the teacher receives the request.
chinese: 延長期限由老師收到申請時開始計算。

english: Removing the outer barrier restores access to the footpath from the north entrance only. Access to the equipment still needs approval.
chinese: 移走外圍圍欄後，行人路恢復通行，限由北面入口進出。遊樂設施仍須獲批准方可使用。

english: Install the sample panel along the straight section.
chinese: 請把樣板安裝在行車線上。

english: Report loose awning brackets to the neighbouring stallholder.
chinese: 簷篷支架如有鬆脫，請通知街市辦事處。

english: The participation certificate records only the hours logged by the facilitator.
chinese: 參與證書只記載活動帶領者登記的時數。

english: The temporary guidance strip is made of ceramic.
chinese: 臨時引路帶以陶瓷製成。

english: Use blue bobbin thread for the demonstration on the sewing machine.
chinese: 使用衣車示範時，請用藍色底線。

english: Please ask the sound technician for assistance with the receiver.
chinese: 如需使用接收器方面的協助，請向音響技術員查詢。

english: Restart the combined cycle only after both chambers have closed and a supervisor has checked the seals.
chinese: 兩個室門均關妥且主管已檢查密封位後，才可重新啟動聯合程序。

english: Before disposing of the packaging, ask the collections officer. The disposal of the item itself follows a different approval process.
chinese: 棄置包裝前，請先徵詢任何展覽訪客。如須處置物品本身，須循另一審批程序。

english: A held reading may be used for marking the interval only.
chinese: 暫停更新的讀數只可用於標示時段。

english: A revised result can be released after the subject head signs the record.
chinese: 須待科主任簽署紀錄後，方可公布修訂成績。

english: If a donated bundle is damp, please keep it apart from the dry bundles and obtain written approval to accept it.
chinese: 捐贈布料如受潮，請與乾燥的布料分開擺放。

english: Enter the rainfall total in millimetres on the fieldwork sheet.
chinese: 請在實地考察工作紙上以毫米填寫總雨量。

english: Fill the insulated jug with hot tea.
chinese: 請把洗潔精倒進保溫壺內。

english: Reinstatement restores the applicant’s place on the waiting list. A display that has already expired must be booked separately.
chinese: 恢復登記後，可恢復申請人的輪候名次。已屆滿的展出時段須另行預訂。

english: If water spills during measurement, mark the entry as incomplete.
chinese: 量度時如有水溢出，請將該項記錄標為未完成。

english: Approval of the sample applies to the finish on the sample board only.
chinese: 樣本的批准只適用於樣本板上的表面效果。

english: hold down the edge before lifting the stencil.
chinese: 拿起模板前，請按住模板邊緣。

english: The pupil may withdraw consent by contacting another exhibitor before publication.
chinese: 學生可於作品刊登前聯絡指定編輯撤回同意。

english: The defective locks are due to be replaced on 12 May. Other services will continue as usual.
chinese: 其他服務照常。預計於5月12日更換有故障的鎖。

english: If the printed and online records disagree, ask another participant to confirm which entry is current.
chinese: 如印刷版與網上紀錄有出入，請課程行政人員確認哪項紀錄為現行版本。

english: Put spare bobbins in the recycling bin after the lesson.
chinese: 課後請把後備梭芯放在線架上。

english: A signed record is sufficient unless the sensor was returned damaged.
chinese: 已簽署的紀錄即可，惟感應器歸還時有損壞除外。

english: The temporary guidance strip is made of rubber.
chinese: 臨時引路帶以木材製成。

english: The envelope for your table contains a bilingual glossary.
chinese: 供你所屬小組使用的信封內有員工更表。

english: If an eyepiece is loose, inform the school receptionist immediately.
chinese: 如目鏡鬆脫，請立即通知天文學會顧問。

english: An exported image can be replaced without unfreezing the chart if a corrected copy is already available.
chinese: 如已有修正版本，毋須解除凍結圖表，即可更換已匯出的圖像。

english: Store the remote control inside the equipment cabinet.
chinese: 請將遙控器存放在器材櫃內。

english: Bring trays with spilled soup to the recycling station.
chinese: 餐盤上如有湯水濺出，請把餐盤送到清洗櫃枱。

english: Thank you for helping at the open day. We have enclosed photographs of the welcome team.
chinese: 感謝各位協助舉辦開放日。隨函附上迎賓小組的照片。

english: If the ribbon is creased, please ask for a replacement before the photograph.
chinese: 如絲帶有摺痕，請在拍照前要求更換。

english: The code can open the temporary compartment identified on the slip only.
chinese: 密碼只可開啟單據上指明的臨時儲物格。

english: Use red bobbin thread for the demonstration on the sewing machine.
chinese: 使用衣車示範時，請用黑色底線。

english: The change takes effect once the administrator approves the request. Messages already sent are unaffected.
chinese: 已發送的電郵不受影響。變更會在管理員批准申請後生效。

english: You may claim an extra entry only if the tutor has verified the task. Please reply with the relevant details.
chinese: 請回覆有關資料。只有在導師已核實有關工作的情況下，才可申報額外項目。

english: Maintenance staff will replace the shower heads this week.
chinese: 維修人員本星期會更換花灑頭。

english: Rinse the paper filter with filtered water.
chinese: 請用過濾水沖洗濾紙。

english: Permission to move the work covers transfer to the announced location alone.
chinese: 搬遷作品的許可只涵蓋搬往公布的地點。

english: Stop recording when the red light flashes.
chinese: 請在關掉錄音機後停止錄音。

english: If the artwork is on loan, permission from the collection manager is required as well.
chinese: 如作品屬借展，亦須取得藏品經理的許可。

english: Cyclists should pass the works area on the left side.
chinese: 單車使用者須從工程範圍左側通過。

english: Use the marked tray to deposit flower seeds.
chinese: 請把花卉種子放入有標記的托盤。

english: Switch the display lamps off before the exhibition opens.
chinese: 請在禮堂關閉時關掉展品照明。

english: The item remains on public display even if the display authorisation has been withdrawn. The organiser will reconsider its placement at the next review.
chinese: 即使改用另一個陳列櫃，物品仍繼續公開展出。主辦方會在下次檢討時重新考慮其擺放位置。

english: Attach the guide bracket above the pulley.
chinese: 請把導向托架裝在滑輪上方。

english: Inspect the emergency switch before starting the pump.
chinese: 請在鎖上泵房後檢查緊急開關掣。

english: Place the pedestrian barrier around the tree pit.
chinese: 請把行人圍欄放在巴士候車亭旁。

english: Only decorative plates may be fired in this batch.
chinese: 本批只可燒製測試用陶件。

english: Fill the insulated jug with chilled water.
chinese: 請把冰水倒進保溫壺內。

english: You can begin practising with the attached track for the encore.
chinese: 附件為安歌曲目的音軌，可供先行練習。

english: Clean the sliding scale using a stiff wire brush.
chinese: 清潔滑動刻度時，請使用乾的超細纖維布。

english: The alert applies to every power supply in the building alone.
chinese: 警示只關乎正在使用的充電埠。

english: Please send questions about the originals to the exhibition curator.
chinese: 如對原件有疑問，請聯絡咖啡店收銀員。

english: Retract the awning before the morning inspection.
chinese: 請在收檔後收起簷篷。

english: To resume automatic redraws, select Resume only after closing the preview. The exported image will stay as it is.
chinese: 匯出的圖像維持原狀。要繼續自動重繪，請選擇「恢復」，但須先關閉預覽。

english: Approval to record an ensemble rehearsal extends to posting a preview online. Publication needs separate consent.
chinese: 樂團彩排的錄製批准涵蓋錄音。發布須另獲同意。

english: Apply the paint with a foam pad.
chinese: 請用海綿墊上色。

english: A pupil’s permission to receive feedback covers feedback from the assigned partner only. Permission to share their own work is recorded separately.
chinese: 學生同意接收評語的範圍僅限獲配對同學的評語。同意分享本人作品的決定則另行記錄。

english: Freezing the chart stops automatic redraws of the chart. Existing values remain visible.
chinese: 原有數值仍然可見。凍結圖表會停止自動重繪圖表。

english: Removing the outer barrier restores access to the footpath during daylight hours. Access to the equipment still needs approval.
chinese: 移走外圍圍欄後，行人路恢復通行，限日間時段。遊樂設施仍須獲批准方可使用。

english: Retract the awning after the stall closes.
chinese: 請在收檔後收起簷篷。

english: Place the pedestrian barrier next to the drain cover.
chinese: 請把行人圍欄放在渠蓋旁。

english: The slot stays with its current holder during the review. Notify the previous applicant, unless the review concerns a different slot.
chinese: 覆核期間，展出時段仍由現時的持有人保留。須通知原申請人。

english: Move the trays out of direct sunlight once the seedlings emerge, including trays that are only partly full.
chinese: 幼苗長出後，須把育苗盤移離陽光直射的位置。

english: An expired certificate is acceptable for locating the stall, provided that the layout has not changed.
chinese: 如識別號碼缺失，可用過期證書辨認攤檔位置。

english: The older pupil may choose the book, provided that both pupils have finished the practice text.
chinese: 只要兩名學生均讀完練習篇章，便可由年長的學生選書。

english: The extension covers every item listed even if several items appear on the request.
chinese: 即使申請列有多項功課，延長期限亦只適用於首項列出的功課。

english: Where the item is jointly owned, request permission from both owners before carrying out the repair.
chinese: 物件如屬共同擁有，維修前須向兩位物主取得許可。

english: Measure downtime from the dispatch of the engineer until service is restored.
chinese: 停用時間由派出工程師起計，直至恢復服務為止。

english: Credits from the previous school count towards graduation. The ranking calculation uses only approved conversions of their grades.
chinese: 舊校學分可計入畢業學分。計算名次時只採用獲批准換算後的該等科目的成績。

english: Only maintenance staff may use the temporary path; the usual route is closed until the works are complete.
chinese: 工程一日未完，原有路線一日不會重開。臨時通道僅供持碼頭通行證人士使用。

english: If the mark itself is unavailable, enter a completion indicator. The system will omit the course from the ranking calculation until review.
chinese: 如找不到原有分數，請輸入完成標記；系統在覆核前不會把該科目計入名次。

english: Apply the finished label beside the serial number.
chinese: 請把完成的標籤貼在通風槽上。

english: The temporary route opens at first light.
chinese: 臨時路線將於日出時分開放。

english: Keep the gym closed until the floor is dry.
chinese: 體育館須暫停開放，直至地板乾透。

english: Place the wet stencil on a clean sheet to dry.
chinese: 請把濕模板放在剛上色的表面晾乾。

english: Thank you for helping at the open day. We have enclosed photographs of the registration team.
chinese: 感謝各位協助舉辦開放日。隨函附上登記小組的照片。

english: A resident may collect supplies for a neighbour only if both households are listed on the form.
chinese: 居民只有在表格列有兩個住戶的情況下才可代鄰居領取物資。

english: Freeze each pack for two hours before first use.
chinese: 首次使用前，每個冰袋須冷凍兩小時。

english: Sow the seeds in the bed beside the main gate.
chinese: 請把種子撒在西牆旁的花圃內。

english: An overnight reading is retained even during a power failure if the recorder operated on battery power.
chinese: 即使停電，只要記錄儀以電池供電運作，仍須保留有關通宵讀數。

english: Each team should take six hockey balls to warm up.
chinese: 每隊須取六個曲棍球熱身。

english:
Pre-infusion
Pour 40 millilitres of water over the grounds. Wait for the flow to stop before the main pour.
chinese:
預先浸潤
請先注水40毫升浸潤咖啡粉，然後待水流停止才開始正式注水。

english: Thank you for approving the interview. Your approval allows us to use the passages you have marked only.
chinese: 感謝你批准訪問。按你所批准的範圍，我們只可使用你標示的段落。

english: If the rope slips, check the post for damage before securing it again.
chinese: 如纜繩鬆脫，請先檢查繫纜樁有否損壞，再把纜繩繫穩。

english: Only unglazed tiles may be fired in this batch.
chinese: 本批只可燒製未上釉的瓷磚。

english: Put the loaded trays in the ventilated cupboard.
chinese: 請把載有香草的托盤放在通風儲物櫃內。

english: If water spills during measurement, mark the entry as incomplete.
chinese: 量度時如有水溢出，請抄錄較早的讀數。

english: The temporary closure affects the entire neighbourhood only.
chinese: 臨時封閉範圍只涉及毗鄰行人路。

english: Retain the original tool in the case unless it has been formally withdrawn.
chinese: 除非它已被正式停用，否則須把原有工具留在工具箱內。

english: An overnight reading is retained even during a power failure if the technician was asleep.
chinese: 即使停電，只要記錄儀以電池供電運作，仍須保留有關通宵讀數。

english: Rinse the paper filter with warm water.
chinese: 請用溫水沖洗濾紙。

english: Before writing, check that the board cannot roll.
chinese: 在白板上書寫前，請確認白板不能滑動。

english: At the start of the lesson, open the window vent by ten centimetres.
chinese: 上課時，請把窗戶的通風口打開十厘米。

english:
Pre-infusion
Pour 30 millilitres of water over the grounds. Wait for the flow to stop before the main pour.
chinese:
預先浸潤
請先注水70毫升浸潤咖啡粉，然後待水流停止才開始正式注水。

english: Place the seating chart on the conductor’s stand before rehearsal.
chinese: 彩排前，請把彩排出席紀錄表放在指揮的譜架上。

english: Please send questions about the originals to the exhibition curator.
chinese: 如對原件有疑問，請聯絡展覽策展人。

english: The older pupil may choose the book, provided that the younger pupil agrees.
chinese: 只要年幼的學生同意，便可由年長的學生選書。

english: A companion may enter the consultation area only if the visitor requests assistance.
chinese: 陪同人士只有在求診人士要求協助的情況下才可進入診症區。

english: Please report faulty sockets at the media desk.
chinese: 如插座故障，請到媒體服務處報告。

english: The alert applies to the active charging port alone.
chinese: 警示只關乎正在使用的充電埠。

english: You can begin practising with the attached track for the interval announcement.
chinese: 附件為第二樂章的音軌，可供先行練習。

english: Use the privacy screen even if the session will be brief.
chinese: 即使診症時間很短，仍須使用遮隔屏風。

english: Please leave the aisle clear behind the percussion section.
chinese: 請保持敲擊樂組後方的通道暢通。

english: The front desk is reserved for the first violins.
chinese: 第一排譜架位置留予第一小提琴組。

english: The temporary guidance strip is made of rubber.
chinese: 臨時引路帶以橡膠製成。

english: The loan is free. A signed waiver covers the loan period only.
chinese: 借用費用全免。已簽署的免責書只適用於借用期。

english: Engage the brake on the front-right castor first.
chinese: 請先鎖緊右前方腳輪的制動掣。

english: The public must remain outside the zone even after the surface dries, except during supervised inspection visits.
chinese: 即使地面已乾，公眾仍須留在封閉範圍外，有專人陪同的巡查到訪除外。

english: The class monitor will check the vent handles during the break.
chinese: 小息期間，當值老師會檢查通風口的把手。

english: Place the pedestrian barrier around the tree pit.
chinese: 請把行人圍欄放在樹穴四周。

english: The ash bin is intended for cold cinders.
chinese: 灰燼桶供棄置已冷卻的煤渣。

english: Crew members should bring six spare collection nets.
chinese: 船員須攜帶兩個後備收集網。

english: The critique sheet should remain anonymous. A maker’s name may be added only once peer comments are complete.
chinese: 作品製作者的姓名只可在同學完成評語後填入，評議表須保持匿名。

english: Where the item is jointly owned, request permission from the repair volunteer before carrying out the repair.
chinese: 物件如屬共同擁有，維修前須向兩位物主取得許可。

english: The communications team will send you a high-resolution copy once it is ready. There is no need to request it separately.
chinese: 毋須另行索取，傳訊組會在高解像度版本備妥後送交各位。

english: Please check whether your box contains the spare playing pieces.
chinese: 請檢查遊戲盒內是否有後備棋子。

english: Please check that the gate has shut once the dog has entered the enclosure.
chinese: 犬隻進入圍封範圍後，請確認閘門已關妥。

english: On the packet, write the date collected in the identifying field.
chinese: 請在種子包裝的識別欄填寫採集日期。

english: Move a pot with a leaking base to the tiled landing.
chinese: 如盆底漏水，請把花盆移到鋪有地磚的樓梯平台。

english: The original player is barred from returning during the entire match.
chinese: 原有隊員在整場比賽期間不得再次上場。

english: Cover the telescope with a dry cloth after use.
chinese: 使用後，請用乾布蓋好望遠鏡。

english: By signing, the donor authorises displaying the item in the indoor area only. Any further use requires a separate agreement.
chinese: 如需用於其他用途，須另訂協議。捐贈者簽署後，僅授權在展期內出售物品。

english: Use a handheld steamer when pressing the costumes.
chinese: 熨燙戲服時，請使用手提蒸氣掛熨機。

english: If a demonstrator resets the sensor, record the reset time in the log before returning it.
chinese: 如示範人員重設感應器，須在歸還前於紀錄冊填寫重設時間。

english: A pupil can revise an earlier response unless the partner has revised their response. The partner’s response remains valid.
chinese: 除非紀錄已結束編輯，否則學生可修改先前的回覆。配對同學的回覆仍然有效。

english: A reproduction permission covers the prize ceremony slideshow alone.
chinese: 複製許可只適用於頒獎典禮的投影片。

english: Fold the legs only when the table is upside down.
chinese: 只有在枱已翻轉至枱面朝下的情況下，才可收摺枱腳。

english: A second receipt is needed only for every passenger on the same trip.
chinese: 只有另一程回程車資才須另附第二張收據。

english: The older pupil may choose the book, provided that the book is from the displayed selection.
chinese: 只要該書屬於陳列的選書，便可由年長的學生選書。

english: By signing, the donor authorises displaying the item for the stated period only. Any further use requires a separate agreement.
chinese: 如需用於其他用途，須另訂協議。捐贈者簽署後，僅授權在指定期間展出物品。

english: Freeze each pack for six hours before first use.
chinese: 首次使用前，每個冰袋須冷凍六小時。

english: Keep the sample labels anonymous even if the maker agrees to be named.
chinese: 即使製作者同意公開姓名，仍須以匿名方式處理製作者的姓名。

english: Retain the original tool in the case unless it has been formally withdrawn.
chinese: 除非替代工具已辦妥借用手續，否則須把原有工具留在工具箱內。

english: Keep the peer comments anonymous even if the maker agrees to be named.
chinese: 即使製作者同意公開姓名，仍須以匿名方式處理同學的評語。

english: This procedure applies only to the original retaining wall.
chinese: 這項程序只適用於相連的金屬欄杆。

english: If sound comes from only one side, report it to the computer technician.
chinese: 如只有一側耳機發出聲音，請通知電腦技術員。

english: This procedure applies only to the sandstone steps.
chinese: 這項程序只適用於砂岩梯級。

english: The loan is free. A signed waiver covers minor wear during the session only.
chinese: 借用費用全免。已簽署的免責書只適用於活動期間的輕微損耗。

english: If both captains object to the replacement, the decision rests with the injured player.
chinese: 如兩位隊長均反對換人，由裁判決定。

english: Your envelope contains the ribbon for the host.
chinese: 信封內是主持人的襟章絲帶。

english: Approval of the sample applies to the coating in indoor light only.
chinese: 樣本的批准只適用於室內照明下的塗層效果。

english: At your appointment, you will be able to handle the replica tablet.
chinese: 在已預約的時段內，你可親手接觸碑板複製品。

english: The temporary route opens after the morning inspection.
chinese: 臨時路線將於早上巡查結束後開放。

english: The contractor may reopen the access lane only after the engineer signs the handover sheet.
chinese: 承辦商只可在工程師簽署交接表後重開通道。

english: After the leaves dry, transfer them to a sealed container.
chinese: 葉片晾乾後，請將其移至密封容器。

english: If two interpreters share the assignment, send the confirmation to the interpreter who accepted first first. We will notify the other interpreter separately.
chinese: 如由兩名傳譯員分擔工作，請先把確認通知發給膳食主管。另一名傳譯員將另獲通知。

english: Our staff collect returns from the returns trolley on Saturdays.
chinese: 星期六，職員在歸還物品手推車接收歸還物品。

english: To help us prepare, send a clear photograph of the entire garment.
chinese: 請傳送整件衣物的清晰照片，以便我們準備。

english: Fasten the canvas to all four corners first.
chinese: 請先把畫布固定在左緣中點。

english: Before berthing during the works, wait for the green signal.
chinese: 工程期間靠岸前，請等候綠色訊號。

english: The screening request permits staff to record the date of attendance only.
chinese: 篩查申請僅容許職員記錄到診日期。

english: A moderator may review feedback from both campuses, but may change comments flagged by the panel only.
chinese: 評分審核員可查閱兩校舍的評語，但只可修改小組標示的評語。

english: Visitors may take three pieces per visit.
chinese: 到訪人士每次可取走三件。

english: The first release unlocks the rinse water outlet. The drying chamber has a separate release.
chinese: 第一道解鎖會解除沖洗排水口的鎖定。乾燥室須另行解鎖。

english: Please close the inner gate once the dog has entered the enclosure.
chinese: 犬隻進入圍封範圍後，請關上內閘。

english: Approval to record an ensemble rehearsal extends to capturing video. Publication needs separate consent.
chinese: 樂團彩排的錄製批准涵蓋錄影。發布須另獲同意。

english: A second work light may be connected only if the supervisor approves the connection.
chinese: 只有在主管批准接駁的情況下，才可接駁第二盞工作燈。

english: Fold the legs only when the table is upside down.
chinese: 只有在枱仍在使用中的情況下，才可收摺枱腳。

english: Collect the envelope from the event desk. It has already been labelled with your name.
chinese: 信封已寫上你的姓名，請到活動服務處領取。

english: Once the container is full, use the adjacent ash bin.
chinese: 收集桶滿載時，請使用旁邊的灰燼桶。

english: The critique sheet should remain anonymous. A maker’s name may be added only after the public display closes.
chinese: 作品製作者的姓名只可在公開展覽結束後填入，評議表須保持匿名。

english: Place the seating chart on the conductor’s stand before rehearsal.
chinese: 彩排前，請把座位編排圖放在指揮的譜架上。

english: Even if the ensemble has approved release, do not use a take featuring a soloist who has withheld consent.
chinese: 即使樂團已批准發布，如該獨奏者未有同意，仍不得使用含有獨奏者演出的錄製版本。

english: A moderator may review feedback from both campuses, but may change comments from their own campus only.
chinese: 評分審核員可查閱兩校舍的評語，但只可修改所屬校舍的評語。

english: A spare apron is available at reception. Please ask the duty attendant if you need it.
chinese: 接待處備有後備圍裙。如有需要，請向當值職員查詢。

english: Maintenance staff will replace the floor grilles this week.
chinese: 維修人員本星期會更換地面格柵。

english: The original player is barred from returning in the same half.
chinese: 原有隊員在同一半場內不得再次上場。

english: Remove the paper tags before pressing the fabric.
chinese: 請在熨布前除去紙標籤。

english: Freeze each pack for four hours before first use.
chinese: 首次使用前，每個冰袋須冷凍四小時。

english: By signing, the donor authorises showing the item alongside the loan pieces only. Any further use requires a separate agreement.
chinese: 如需用於其他用途，須另訂協議。捐贈者簽署後，僅授權把物品與借展展品一同展出。

english: For this exchange, the organiser is accepting unused wool.
chinese: 本次交換活動，主辦方接收未用過的羊毛料。

english: Before replacing the bobbin, raise the presser foot.
chinese: 更換梭芯前，請抬起壓腳。

english: Shelves for dry clothing are located beside the changing rooms.
chinese: 放置乾衣物的層架位於更衣室旁。

english: close the jaws before setting the reading to zero.
chinese: 將讀數歸零前，請把量爪拉至最開。

english: Where two pupils share a sensor, the pupil listed as borrower must sign the equipment record.
chinese: 兩名學生共用一個感應器時，須由名列借用人的學生在器材紀錄上簽署。

english: Maintenance staff will replace the control valves this week.
chinese: 維修人員本星期會更換控制閥。

english: Dog waste bags are available in the administration building.
chinese: 狗糞袋可於飲水龍頭旁領取。

english: Seats with hearing loop coverage are located on the balcony.
chinese: 有感應環線覆蓋的座位位於首三排。

english: Engage the brake on the front-left castor first.
chinese: 請先鎖緊左前方腳輪的制動掣。

english: Before placing a piece on the rack, remove the rack label.
chinese: 把木料放上層架前，請除去突出的釘子。

english: We will supply gloves. Please bring a magnifying glass.
chinese: 我們會提供手套，請另備放大鏡。

english: The slot stays with its current holder during the review. Notify the previous applicant, unless the review concerns a different slot.
chinese: 覆核期間，展出時段仍由現時的持有人保留。須通知原申請人，惟覆核涉及另一展出時段則除外。

english: Ask the transcription reviewer to review the spelling of street names.
chinese: 請謄寫審核員覆核街道名稱的串法。

english: Use a padded ironing board when pressing the costumes.
chinese: 熨燙戲服時，請使用有襯墊的熨衣板。

english: The reservation covers the labelled shelf bay only. The floor must remain clear.
chinese: 須保持地面暢通。預留安排只涵蓋所有未使用的層架。

english: Before the technician loads the kiln, check each piece for cracks.
chinese: 技術員把陶件放入窯爐前，請撕去層架上的標籤。

english: We will remove items when the booking ends unless an extension has been approved.
chinese: 預訂期結束後，我們會移走物品，除非延長預訂期已獲批准。

english: Only the reading coordinator needs to record the pages when pupils read as a pair.
chinese: 兩人一組閱讀時，只須由聆聽的學生記錄頁數。

english: If sound comes from only one side, report it to the canteen manager.
chinese: 如只有一側耳機發出聲音，請通知監堂老師。

english: You will receive fitting notes before you attend the fitting.
chinese: 我們會於全部試穿完成後發送試穿記錄。

english: Water the plants just before every lesson.
chinese: 請最後一堂課後為植物澆水。

english: Tighten the canvas with the adjustable tensioner.
chinese: 請用可調校的張緊器拉緊畫布。

english: Use a cotton pressing cloth when pressing the costumes.
chinese: 熨燙戲服時，請使用棉質隔布。

english: Line the tray with used newspaper before adding the herbs.
chinese: 把香草放進托盤前，請先用焗爐紙墊底。

english: Tie the bow line to the first mooring post.
chinese: 請把船首纜繩繫於第一個繫纜樁。

english: While the display is on hold, enter the independently verified reading in the log.
chinese: 顯示器暫停更新時，須在紀錄中填寫經獨立核實的讀數。

english: The rehearsal recording includes a piano introduction to help singers enter together.
chinese: 練習錄音加入了鋼琴引子，有助團員一同起唱。

english: Include people who reached the boarding area but did not sail in the daily terminal total. The count of passengers who actually sailed is reported separately.
chinese: 每日碼頭人數總計須包括抵達登船區但沒有乘船的人。實際乘船的人數須另行呈報。

english: Please invite the opposition captain to deliver the opening speech.
chinese: 請邀請反方隊長發表開場陳詞。

english: Your fitting appointment is for the denim apron.
chinese: 已為你預約試穿牛仔布圍裙。

english: Tie the bow line to the third mooring post.
chinese: 請把船首纜繩繫於第三個繫纜樁。

english: The extension covers the first item listed even if several items appear on the request.
chinese: 即使申請列有多項功課，延長期限亦只適用於首項列出的功課。

english: Bring trays with spilled soup to the cleaning trolley.
chinese: 餐盤上如有湯水濺出，請把餐盤送到清潔手推車。

english: A group can reserve shared shelf space if all users agree to the sharing terms.
chinese: 小組如小組帳戶已被暫停使用，可預留共用層架空間。

english: Please leave the aisle clear behind the percussion section.
chinese: 請保持大提琴譜架之間的通道暢通。

english: We will supply gloves. Please bring a soft pencil.
chinese: 我們會提供手套，請另備軟芯鉛筆。

english: During the works, use the shower facilities near the north gate.
chinese: 工程期間，請使用北閘附近的淋浴設施。

english: If an eyepiece is loose, inform the astronomy club adviser immediately.
chinese: 如目鏡鬆脫，請立即通知天文學會顧問。

english: Ask the printer operator to review the spelling of street names.
chinese: 請當區歷史研究員覆核街道名稱的串法。

english: Additional coats may be applied only when the gloss level has been checked.
chinese: 只有在光澤度已核實的情況下，才可再加塗層。

english: Shower cubicles are cleaned after the morning session.
chinese: 淋浴間於游泳課期間清潔。

english: An existing grower may nominate a successor only if all outstanding dues are settled.
chinese: 只有在所有欠款已清繳的情況下，現有種植者才可提名接任人。

english: The reservation covers space assigned by the custodian only. The floor must remain clear.
chinese: 須保持地面暢通。預留安排只涵蓋管理員編配的空間。

english: Count a passenger who disembarks and returns only once, unless they join a separately ticketed sailing.
chinese: 離船後折返的乘客只計一次，除非乘客參加另行售票的航班。

english: Use speed setting four during the introductory session.
chinese: 入門訓練時段請使用四號速度設定。

english: At the start of the lesson, open the window vent by fifteen centimetres.
chinese: 上課時，請把窗戶的通風口打開十五厘米。

english: Move a pot with a leaking base to the tiled landing.
chinese: 如盆底漏水，請把花盆移到鋪有地氈的閱讀角。

english: Place the folded table beside the marked trolley.
chinese: 請把摺合後的枱放在緊急出口前。

english: Add 20 millilitres of lubricant to the bearing.
chinese: 請向軸承加入20毫升潤滑油。

english: The collection boat will service the inner basin today.
chinese: 清理船今天會在內港水域進行清理。

english: Nominating a successor transfers the right to cultivate only after approval.
chinese: 提名接任人獲批後，只會轉交種植權。

english: Wipe the headphones with a dry cloth after use.
chinese: 使用後，請用乾布抹拭耳機。

english: Shower cubicles are cleaned during the afternoon break.
chinese: 淋浴間於下午休息時段內清潔。

english: Unused speaking time should be recorded by the timekeeper.
chinese: 未用的發言時間須由計時員記錄。

english: Please report a loose indicator tile to the accessibility inspector.
chinese: 如有觸覺引路磚鬆脫，請通知無障礙設施督察。

english: The alert applies to the battery’s external temperature alone.
chinese: 警示只關乎電池外部溫度。

english: Clean the sliding scale using an air blower.
chinese: 清潔滑動刻度時，請使用吹塵球。

english: Set the display to inches for this check.
chinese: 進行本項檢查時，請把顯示器設為以英吋顯示。

english: If two interpreters share the assignment, send the confirmation to the designated lead interpreter first. We will notify the other interpreter separately.
chinese: 如由兩名傳譯員分擔工作，請先把確認通知發給指定的首席傳譯員。另一名傳譯員將另獲通知。

english: Keep the dog on a short lead until it is inside the exercise area.
chinese: 犬隻進入活動區前，須一直使用短牽引帶。

english: Hang the headphone cable beside the monitor bracket.
chinese: 請把耳機線掛在顯示器支架旁。

english: Where the two devices disagree, ask the works supervisor to decide which record to use.
chinese: 兩台儀器的結果如不一致，須請工程主管決定採用哪項紀錄。

english: Report loose awning brackets to the market office.
chinese: 簷篷支架如有鬆脫，請通知街市辦事處。

english: If sound comes from only one side, report it to the supervising teacher.
chinese: 如只有一側耳機發出聲音，請通知監堂老師。

english: Please invite a guest debater to deliver the opening speech.
chinese: 請邀請嘉賓辯論員發表開場陳詞。

english: Tie the bow line to the first mooring post.
chinese: 請把船首纜繩繫於第七個繫纜樁。

english: An unused award balance can be applied to the next invoice for the current term only.
chinese: 未用完的獎學金餘額只可用於本學期下一張繳費單。

english: A stoppage during maintenance is excluded except when the schedule is displayed at the entrance.
chinese: 保養期間暫停運作不計在內，惟肇因與保養無關除外。

english: Use the privacy screen even if no other visitors are waiting.
chinese: 即使沒有其他求診人士等候，仍須使用遮隔屏風。

english: Please start queuing after the morning briefing. Slots are already assigned.
chinese: 維修時段已編配。請於上午簡介結束後開始排隊。

english: Please invite the affirmative captain to deliver the opening speech.
chinese: 請邀請正方隊長發表開場陳詞。

english: Put the loaded trays on the shaded shelf.
chinese: 請把載有香草的托盤放在背光的架上。

english: Pedestrian access may resume after the cut branches are removed.
chinese: 移走剪下的樹枝後可恢復行人通行。

english: Switch the display lamps off when the hall closes.
chinese: 請在禮堂關閉時關掉展品照明。

english: The replacement order covers the covers bordering the work site alone.
chinese: 更換指令只涵蓋工程地盤邊緣的渠蓋。

english: Please leave the aisle clear beside the piano.
chinese: 請保持鋼琴旁的通道暢通。

english: remove used napkins before stacking the trays.
chinese: 將餐盤疊放前，請掃描餐盤條碼。

english: If both captains object to the replacement, the decision rests with the referee.
chinese: 如兩位隊長均反對換人，由裁判決定。

english: To pack away the frame, remove the fabric first.
chinese: 收起支架前，請先拆下布幕。

english: Before the main cleaning, test a soft brush on a small patch of stone.
chinese: 正式清潔前，請選一小塊石面試用硬毛刷。

english: The anonymity rule applies to all work except teacher demonstration pieces.
chinese: 除老師的示範作品外，所有作品均須遵守匿名規定。

english: Each model bridge will be tested with a two-kilogram load.
chinese: 每座橋樑模型會以兩公斤負重測試。

english: Collect the envelope from the recycling trolley. It has already been labelled with your name.
chinese: 信封已寫上你的姓名，請到活動服務處領取。

english: Our staff collect returns at the reading room entrance on Saturdays.
chinese: 星期六，職員在室外遊戲桌接收歸還物品。

english: At the start of the lesson, open the window vent by fifteen centimetres.
chinese: 上課時，請把窗戶的通風口打開二十厘米。

english: Before the technician loads the kiln, check each piece for cracks.
chinese: 技術員把陶件放入窯爐前，請檢查每件陶件有沒有裂痕。

english: The ash bin is intended for hot embers.
chinese: 灰燼桶供棄置用過的燃料磚。

english: Dog waste bags are available at the gate dispenser.
chinese: 狗糞袋可於閘門旁的供應器領取。

english: Use the backup outlet for the standby fan only. Start the remaining equipment separately.
chinese: 其他設備須另行啟動；後備插座只可用於緊急指示燈。

english: We would like to use one of the photographs in the event summary. Please reply if you would prefer us to leave it out.
chinese: 如不希望採用有關照片，請回覆本電郵。我們擬在付費廣告牌上使用其中一張照片。

english: Please dismount and walk at the shared crossing.
chinese: 途經共用過路處時，請下車步行。

english: Hang the headphone cable across the keyboard tray.
chinese: 請把耳機線掛在電腦桌的掛鈎上。

english: Your fitting appointment is for the leather apron.
chinese: 已為你預約試穿皮革圍裙。

english: If both pupils want to change partners, submit the request through the pupils’ existing partner. An individual request follows the same process.
chinese: 如兩名學生均希望更換配對同學，須經朋輩學習統籌員提交申請。個別申請亦按相同程序辦理。

english: hold down the edge before lifting the stencil.
chinese: 拿起模板前，請往圖案上加水。

english: Issue a temporary code only to someone who can confirm the locker identification.
chinese: 只有能確認儲物櫃的識別資料的人士方可獲發臨時密碼。

english: The closure affects the resurfaced zone.
chinese: 封閉範圍包括重鋪地面區域及圍欄旁通道。

english: Before loosening the screw, pull the blind sharply.
chinese: 鬆開螺絲前，請托穩窗簾。

english: Move the trays out of direct sunlight once the seedlings emerge, including trays that are only partly full.
chinese: 幼苗長出後，須把育苗盤移離陽光直射的位置，未放滿的育苗盤亦須移走。

english: Sow the seeds in the bed nearest the hall.
chinese: 請把種子撒在最接近禮堂的花圃內。

english: Please report faulty sockets at the security booth.
chinese: 如插座故障，請到圖書館服務櫃枱報告。

english: When a subscriber leaves the affiliate list, remove them from the main mailing list. Their main account will remain active.
chinese: 訂戶的主帳戶維持有效。訂戶退出聯屬名單時，須同時從聯屬通訊摘要名單移除該訂戶。

english: Please start queuing after the morning briefing. Slots are already assigned.
chinese: 維修時段已編配。請於活動結束時開始排隊。

english: Before adding a second row of staples, check the tension.
chinese: 加上第二排釘書釘前，請檢查張力。

english: Do not run the routine test while the gate is in service unless the backup gate is available.
chinese: 閘門運作期間不得進行例行測試，除非後備閘門可供使用。

english: Seats with hearing loop coverage are located near the central aisle.
chinese: 有感應環線覆蓋的座位位於中央通道附近。

english: Thank you for helping at the open day. We have enclosed photographs of the floor guides.
chinese: 感謝各位協助舉辦開放日。隨函附上場內導賞員的照片。

english: Each model bridge will be tested with a three-kilogram load.
chinese: 每座橋樑模型會以四公斤負重測試。

english: For a voice you cannot identify, use the label “Speaker unknown”. Continue transcribing the passage.
chinese: 請繼續謄寫有關段落。無法辨認說話者時，請標示為「說話者不詳」。

english: To receive the interpretation feed, select channel two.
chinese: 如欲接收傳譯聲道，請選用第二聲道。

english: Each team should take eight hockey balls to warm up.
chinese: 每隊須取十個曲棍球熱身。

english: Please report a loose indicator tile to the district works office.
chinese: 如有觸覺引路磚鬆脫，請通知地區工程辦事處。

english: The awning must extend no farther than the kerb.
chinese: 簷篷伸展不得超越路緣。

english: A pupil’s permission to receive feedback covers publication of their own work only. Permission to share their own work is recorded separately.
chinese: 學生同意接收評語的範圍僅限口頭評語。同意分享本人作品的決定則另行記錄。

english: Before loosening the screw, support the blind.
chinese: 鬆開螺絲前，請托穩窗簾。

english: End the hold only if the supervisor confirms that recording can resume.
chinese: 只有在主管確認可以恢復記錄的情況下，才可結束暫停更新。

english: The extension starts when the pupil receives the approval.
chinese: 延長期限由學生收到批准通知時開始計算。

english: Apply the award against the activity fee before calculating any balance payable.
chinese: 計算應繳餘額前，先以獎學金抵銷活動費。

english: The session will start beside the model cabinet. Our guide will meet you there.
chinese: 導賞員會在活動開始的地點與你會合。活動將於模型陳列櫃旁開始。

english: If the artwork is on loan, permission from the lender is required as well.
chinese: 如作品屬借展，亦須取得出借人的許可。

english: Apply the finished label along the upper edge.
chinese: 請把完成的標籤貼在上邊緣沿線。

english: This message confirms a repair slot for a loose button.
chinese: 現確認已為多士爐故障預留維修時段。

english: While the display is on hold, enter the most recent live reading in the log.
chinese: 顯示器暫停更新時，須在紀錄中填寫最近一次實時讀數。

english: Install the sample panel at the foot of the ramp.
chinese: 請把樣板安裝在斜道底部。

english: Set the display to metres for this check.
chinese: 進行本項檢查時，請把顯示器設為以英吋顯示。
